Mejía propone que Aurelio pierda su anonimato. Mónica está furiosa porque Casillas no le contesta el celular. Ponte le dice a Marco Mejía que ya tiene a sus hombres listos para la operación.
Jiménez da luz verde para ir por Casillas, y Mejía comienza un operativo para desmantelar toda la organización. Mónica le exige a Aurelio que active el negocio con Guadalupe.
Aurelio se ofrece a ayudar a Lupe para rescatar a Mónica, pero él se niega, muy molesto. El Cabo le dice a Casillas que las cosas se complicaron: se preparan para el enfrentamiento.
Aurelio le dispara a Jairo y el Cabo lo remata. Casillas se deja seducir por la ardiente Mónica. Eugenia le dice a Linares que está preocupada por el artículo que escribió en el periódico.
Aurelio le dice a Ximena que no se le ocurra hacerle algo al bebé que espera, ante sus reclamos. Compra un 727 para transportar la droga, mientras él y sus hombres viajan en otro avión por seguridad.
El Cabo le pregunta a Aurelio quién es Letrudo, y se une a los planes para vengarse con Chacorta y el Turco. Víctor llega al estudio de grabación para ver cómo va Matilde con el tema del disco.
La guerrilla retiene a Aurelio y Socorro, y él le pide a Chacorta que lo rescate cuando las negociaciones se complican. La Tijera le dice a Guadalupe que Casillas recuperó la droga.
Oscar obliga a Dobladillo a hablar por teléfono con Canica, quien le da la ubicación del comandante Macario, con quien debe de estar Aurelio. Mejía y Jiménez contactan a la agente Leonor Ballesteros.
Aurelio le presenta a Mónica a la nueva piloto que contrató, pero ella la hace sentir incómoda. Ximena sorprende a su hijo Heriberto en una situación sospechosa con la tía Matilde.
El Turco le avisa al coronel Jiménez del nuevo cargamento que llega de Colombia, y le entrega la foto del Pombo para que sepa a quién deben arrestar, pero Leonor resulta herida en la operación.
Roxana le pide dinero a Guadalupe, pero él la toma por la fuerza y se aprovecha de ella. Mónica indaga sobre los contactos de su hermano. El coronel Jiménez le cuenta a Doris sobre su ascenso.
Jiménez recibe un regalo especial. Chacorta llega a una colonia y hace un estudio para el expendio de la droga, habla con Aurelio y le dice que es una buena oportunidad de negocio en el país.
Aurelio tiene controlado todo el mercado del país con la venta en las colonias, y le pide a Irina que lo ponga en contacto con el presidente. Ella dice que con él no, pero sí con su primo.
Marco Mejía le dice a Jiménez que deben desmantelar la red de distribución que tienen los Casillas en las colonias. Los Villalobos llaman para pedir una cita con Aurelio.
Los Villalobos se enteran de lo que sucede con Casillas y quieren aprovechar para sacarlo del negocio. Aurelio le pide a Chacorta que les dé un susto a los periodistas para vengarse.
Marco Mejía trata de interceptar las comunicaciones de los Casillas, pero decide renunciar porque se siente culpable por las muertes de personas inocentes. Aurelio ordena eliminar a Eugenia.
Heriberto cae en las provocaciones de Matilde. Chacorta le dispara a Eugenia, pero hiere a Linares. Mejía se enfrenta a tiros con él y es Chacorta quien resulta herido, aunque logra escapar.
Aurelio jura que Mejía se las va a pagar. Doña Alba hace entrega de los documentos de un lote de terreno, con el fin de presionar para que reciban nuevamente a Rutila en la escuela.
Los Villalobos secuestran a Ximena, mientras Aurelio y Mónica se reencuentran. Doris y Jiménez organizan una cena con altos funcionarios del Gobierno por el nombramiento de Benítez.
Sonia escucha la conversación que tiene Ramiro con Irina y decide arruinarlo. Juan Villalobos le dice a Ximena que están enterados de los amoríos de Heriberto y Matilde. Leonor activa su plan.
El Cabo visita a Aurelio para contarle que lo quieren sacar del negocio y le pide que le dé una ruta; además, lo ayudará para rescatar a Ximena. Mejía usa una estrategia que incomoda a Jiménez.
Sonia amenaza a Ramiro con contar todo durante la reunión, pero él le advierte que, si lo hace, uno de sus socios se encargará de acabar con ella. Guadalupe atenta contra Sabino.
El presidente le pide a Mejía una lista de funcionarios sospechosos involucrados con el narcotráfico. Marco se entera de que Aurelio se infiltró en la policía y don Cleto mandó a matar a su padre.
Matilde le reprocha a Chacorta el haber tenido un hijo con Aída. Sonia se va a confesar y le pide al sacerdote una cita con el cardenal para confesarle algo muy grave, y le da una libreta negra.

El Cabo y Tijeras se apoderan de la organización de Oscar Cadena, lo dejan herido y deciden entregarlo a las autoridades. Aurelio encuentra muertos a los Villalobos, por lo que le reclama a su suegro.
Sonia se reúne con el cardenal para enseñarle la libreta que compromete a Ramiro con el narcotráfico, y recibe una amenaza de su esposo. Leonor y Marco Mejía pasan la noche juntos.
Eugenia se molesta con el cambio en el periódico. Mejía convence a Jiménez de no estar dispuesto a trabajar más con Leonor, y ella entra al estudio de grabación haciéndose pasar por fan de Alejo.
En una entrevista íntima, divertida y llena de verdades, Natti Natasha abre su corazón para hablar de su primer beso, la maternidad y cómo esa experiencia transformó su vida personal y profesional.

Yeri Mua abre su mundo más personal: sus rituales y limpias para proteger su energía, las malas experiencias que la han marcado en el amor, y cómo define a su tipo ideal. Además, revela cuáles son las red flags que no puede tolerar en una relación.
Rocío decide mudarse a casa de Paco con su nuevo esposo y sus hijos, pero las cosas terminan muy mal cuando Monserrat y Toña coquetean con él.

La investigación sobre Mia continúa y se cierne sobre Iván, pero aparecen teorías acerca de otros sospechosos. David recibe mensajes inquietantes y Greg no encuentra la paz. Maya hace preguntas incómodas a la persona equivocada.
El nuevo frontón femenino es una realidad, pero en Donosti no todos están dispuestos a ponérselo fácil a Idoia e Itzi. En México, Chelo decide empezar de cero y hace las maletas para viajar a España.

Piso 21 habla sobre su álbum "TRESCENDER", su encuentro con David Beckham y Marc Anthony, y cómo han logrado sobrevivir en la industria musical tras dejar Colombia, evolucionando su sonido y manteniéndose vigentes en la música latina.

Zhamira Zambrano vive su primer tour presentando su álbum "Curita para el corazón", compartiendo momentos especiales con su hija. Entre emociones y desafíos, sigue adelante incluso cuando ha querido rendirse, encontrando en la música su fuerza.
María Becerra comparte cómo es su proceso creativo en la música y cómo está construyendo su próximo álbum.
Corina Smith abre el corazón y la libreta de notas detrás de su segundo álbum, "Menos triste más mami".
José José muestra la realidad de la vida de una estrella y cómo la fama, el dinero, y los placeres pueden destruirlo.
Magdalena habla con los vecinos para pedirles que la apoyen a evitar que pongan un baile de mesa en el barrio. Germán y Pedro convencen a Arturo de que los apoye para que sí lo abran.

Los vecinos tienen que reponer la pintura que el gobierno les dio para pintar la fachada del edificio, pero que utilizaron para uso personal. Carlitos se quedará unos días con Pedro y Luis. Germán se ofrece para pintar la fachada del edificio.
Una casualidad provoca que las mamás de Vítor y Albertano lleguen a casa de Doña Cuca justo el día de las madres, sin que ellos estén enterados.

Doña Cuca les consigue trabajo a Vítor y a Albertano en la panadería de la colonia; Vítor descubre su talento para preparar bolillos con su ingrediente secreto, mientras que Albertano vive un amor frustrado con la hija del panadero.
La familia López cree que Licha es reptiliana, pues presenta todos los rasgos que los identifican. Además, a Plácido le han robado el taxi, y ahora será parte de una estudiantina.
Don Justo se presenta en la puerta del departamento de la familia López para ofrecerle un nuevo trabajo a Plácido, pero a cambio de una condición. Además, Plutarco se va de casa.
Un joven con una preferencia sexual diferente juega con los sentimientos de la hermana de su mejor amigo para evitar que la gente hable de él.

Cuatro jóvenes se dedican a organizar eventos donde hacen retos arriesgando sus vidas para vender sus experiencias en las redes sociales. Una de las jóvenes se presenta en una fiesta consumiendo muchas drogas y fallece.

Mirian y Gerson serán padres; sin embargo, Fabián, el vecino de Gerson, está obsesionado con él y decide secuestrarlo para estar juntos siempre. Con el paso de los años, Gerson intentará escapar de su captor.
Vicente vende rosas desde niño y sueña con ser arquitecto para construirle una casa a su madre. Una tragedia lo lleva a un orfanato, separándolo de su amiga Jazmín.

Gloria Trevi abre su historia como nunca en una conversación profunda y sin filtros con Alejandra Espinoza. Desde sus inicios hasta convertirse en un ícono indiscutible de la música latina, la artista recorre los momentos que definieron su vida.
Paolo termina su relación con Sabrina. Damián se lleva una sorpresa cuando ve a Gael en la casa de Elisa.

Clara dice que Lola le hizo firmar la cesión de las escrituras de su departamento. Leona es secuestrada por órdenes de Calixto. Lola le asegura a Jacinta que Benjamín no es su hermano. Calixto intenta abusar de Leona; Ramsés la salva.

Adolfo sospecha que María siente celos de Montserrat. Adolfo le aconseja a María robarle dinero a Alejandro para después acusar a Montserrat de haberlo hecho. José Luis decide irse del pueblo para evitar que la policía lo atrape.
José Luis decide terminar su relación con Montserrat. Esmeralda idea un plan para lograr que Refugio escape de la cárcel. Rosario le agradece a Alejandro por haberla aceptado de nuevo en la hacienda.
Arturo cuestiona a Teresa sobre la relación que tuvo con Mariano y si pasaron la noche juntos. Teresa se ofende porque Arturo cree que lo engañó con Mariano y pretende hacerlo sufrir.
Teresa acepta convertirse en socia del despacho de Arturo. Aurora desea descubrir la razón por la cual su madre la abandonó. Teresa le dice a Arturo que no quiere tener un hijo con él.

Ana Leticia, fingiendo ser Ana Lucía, le dice a Ana Laura que lo único que le interesa es el dinero y que no la quiere en su vida. Marcelo va a ver a Remedios al hospital y le agradece por salvarle la vida.
Los padres de Silvia le confiesan que Teresa es su abuela y ella decide ir a buscarla. Rodrigo despierta y descubre que Mónica sabe que está vivo.
Ana Laura descubre a Ramiro besándose con Maribel y termina su relación con él. Facundo le cuenta a Ana Leticia que Evaristo trabajaba para él y mata a Orlando e Iñaki frente a ella.
Teresa niega ser la abuela de Silvia. Mónica descubre que su padre anunció frente a todos sus empleados que se casará con Renata. Carmen vuelve a sufrir un ataque durante el concurso de baile.
Gael enfrenta a Damián y le aclara que Elisa va a ser su mujer. El padre Guadalupe le dice a Florencia que su matrimonio es falso.
¿Cuál será la reacción de Columba al enterarse de que Gael está enamorado de Leona? Los Torrenegro le piden ayuda a Romeo para convencer a Ana Ju de regresar a casa.

Refugio le dice a Esmeralda que pronto ideará un plan para poder salir de prisión y volver a estar con ella. Alejandro decide irse a Agua Azul para poder hacerle justicia a Juventino. José Luis encuentra a Refugio golpeado en la hacienda.
José Luis le confiesa a Alejandro que Loreto planeaba matarlo. Montserrat sospecha que María es la ladrona de la hacienda. Nadia teme que Pedro mate a Víctor al saber de sus encuentros pasionales.
Omar y Fernando van juntos a un bar y Alicia se disfraza para espiarlos; Tomás juega billar con Sánchez y Rosales.
Alicia le dice a Marcia que sospecha que Fernando fue a una casa de citas; Julieta y Don Erasmo le presumen a Fernando todos los logros académicos de Lety.
Román y un joven se suben al automóvil de Marcia y Alicia y reciben una rociada de gas pimienta; se arma un escándalo y todos son llevados a la delegación para aclarar la situación.
Fernando lleva a Lety a un hotel y hacen el amor por primera vez. Fernando no ama a Lety, pero sabe que fue una noche muy especial.

Paula María le cuenta a Lety sobre su noche con Simón; Jazmín se enoja con Efrén porque no quiere pedir la mitad de la casa de Lola; Fernando intenta explicarle a Lety que no pasó nada entre él y Marcia en el departamento.

Jazmín se niega a salir con Efrén, acepta la invitación de Simón y apaga el celular; Lety se atraganta al escuchar a Lola decir que la cuestionó Marcia; Alicia cuelga el teléfono cuando Román la reconoce.

Alicia se niega a empeñar sus joyas y su automóvil. Fernando pone a Carolina, Marcia, Luigi y Omar al tanto de las nuevas contrataciones. Luigi menciona la boda entre Fernando y Marcia, de modo que Lety se pone triste.
Efrén le dice a Jazmín que pedirá la mitad de la casa de Lola; Ariel amenaza a Fernando con pedir la disolución de la empresa si no se casa con Marcia.
Fernando le declara su amor a Lety y le pide que se queden juntos; Martha le confiesa a Paco que la liposucción no le sirvió de nada, pero él le asegura que la quiere así.
Lety se emociona al leer la tarjeta que Fernando le dejó; Simón lleva a Patricia Manterola a conocer al personal de Conceptos y Alicia le avisa a Marcia de inmediato.

Alicia le aconseja a Marcia ir tras Patricia Manterola; Omar le dice a Fernando que Lety salió destrozada de la oficina. Fernando acepta que Luigi trabaje para Patricia Manterola. Marcia, Omar y Fernando viajan a Alemania.
Leticia y el Cuartel de las Feas asisten al museo de cera. Marcia y Alicia van para tratar de descubrir a Fernando con su amante y Omar le aconseja a Fernando seducir de nuevo a Lety.
Alicia le sugiere a Marcia buscar a Fernando; Omar le ofrece su departamento a Fernando para llevar a Lety; Paula María se molesta porque escucha a Simón decirle a Celso que saldrán con unas chicas.
Román y sus amigos interceptan a Alicia y le reclaman por sus mentiras; Lety le recuerda a Fernando sobre la llegada de Miguel y la apuesta que hizo con Román.
Marcia le dice a Alicia que no quiere viajar con Fernando quien le confiesa a Omar que ya no quiere seguir engañando a Lety porque ella lo ama.
Román le deja un recado por teléfono a Alicia; Fernando impide que Lety se vaya; Luigi ofende a las del cuartel, Cristina se molesta con él y lo obliga a que se las presente.
Fernando le da a Lety un regalo y una tarjeta donde le pide olvidar el pasado y volver a tener fe; Fernando y Marcia se despiden. Marcia invita a comer a Lety para sacarle información.
Simón se lleva a los niños y Efrén se lo reclama a Lola, pero ella le hace ver que Paco y Simón han sido mejores padres que él; Lety se niega a contarles a las del cuartel lo que habló con Marcia.
El chisme de que Fernando se peleó llega a oídos del cuartel. Los papás de Fernando le piden a Lety que arregle el regalo de bodas.

Omar urge a Fernando que encuentre la bolsa roja, pues si cae en manos equivocadas, se sabrá todo lo que han ocultado para salvar la empresa: Fernando le dice a Sara que la bolsa tiene muestras para laboratorio.
Fernando confunde a Marcia con Lety por teléfono; Marcia le dice a Fernando que no lo quiere perder, Lety se convence de dejarlo ir.
Alicia cuestiona a las del cuartel y culpa a Juanita de haber tomado la bolsa; Matilde intenta besar a Tomás durante la filmación, pero él le dice que se casará con Leticia.
Luigi se va a Alemania para filmar el comercial de Sport Wing; Fernando le entrega a Lety un dibujo que le hizo; Lety habla por teléfono en clave con Teresita para explicarle su encargo.
Fernando deja su automóvil a media calle para ir tras Lety; las del cuartel se encargan de conseguir lo necesario para filmar el comercial; Raúl y Simón hacen la audición a las modelos.
Se lleva a cabo en Conceptos la audición de las modelos en traje de baño, y Alicia decide que ella quiere ser la modelo del comercial y hará todo para conseguirlo.
Efrén busca a Jazmín y Fernando le pide a Simón que le ayude a encontrarla; Paula María logra que Pilar Zacarías, la modelo a la que quería contratar Luigi, se presente en Conceptos.
El cuartel de las feas trata de complacer los deseos de Pilar para la realización del comercial y Lety le dice que Fernando tiene una doble vida.
Don Erasmo le cuelga a Matilde; Alicia y Pilar chocan sus carritos en el supermercado; Lety le cuenta a Fernando por qué nunca aprendió a cocinar y él acepta que tampoco sabe.
As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger; Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog, Reuben, who is couch-bound with arthritis.

Julian operates on a French Bulldog that has injured one of his three legs; Matt Smith rushes to a farm to try and save a ewe and her unborn lamb; Peter and Shona have some donkey work to do at the Greens' farm.

Matt Smith heads to Cannon Hall Farm where Rob and Dave's latest arrival, a Highland calf, has serious breathing problems; Rohin Aojula takes his dad on a call to help a horse that has suffered a nasty injury while out riding.

Peter Wright treats a pet sheep with flystrike, resulting in maggots living in its ear; the Huddersfield team performs spinal surgery on a French Bulldog; Julian Norton meets pet pig Pumba that has hay netting tangled around its teeth.

Peter treats two wild owls brought into his practice; Shona rushes to the aid of a horse that has trodden on a nail; Julian has to learn sign language in order to communicate with a deaf dachshund that requires surgery.

Matt and David meet Jon Bon Pony; Peter treats a farmer's Labrador who's struggling to walk after cutting herself on a nail; Julian operates on a chicken with an infected leg; Robin aids a pregnant ewe.
Two pet goats have been attacked by an unknown animal; Peter visits an old friend's farm to help a pig; a dog has eaten children's vitamin pills.

Peter Wright treats two kittens that have been dumped in a bag and set on fire; Shona performs an emergency cesarean to try and save a cow and her calf; Julian hopes to help a dog suffering from a rare spinal condition.
A calf is struggling with a suspected hernia; Matt investigates Maggie's condition; Julian removes one of the largest lumps his team has ever seen on a dog.
Peter's friend heads down to the practice with a sheep who had one lamb last night, but is struggling to give birth to her second.
A newborn lamb is brought to the hospital after being found abandoned by the roadside; the lamb arrived in a bag for life, but Matt and David have their work cut out to save his life.
It's a landmark day at the hospital in Huddersfield, as Shona and the team use a new electrochemotherapy treatment on a pet pygmy goat's cancerous tumor; Peter heads into surgery.
Julian faces an uphill struggle at the Thirsk practice; a Large Munsterlander has a cancerous tumor on his jaw.
Julian Norton treats a cat with a badly swollen eye, and helps a ewe deliver twin lambs; Peter deals with a bull terrier with halitosis.
Julian risks life and limb to inject a ferocious pig; Peter examines elderly clients Steve and Jeanie Green's dairy herd.
Julian tries to help a cow that's struggling to deliver a huge calf; the vets help a puppy that has swallowed an extension cord.
Julian tries to help Bluebell as she prepares to give birth; Peter treats a lamb; a rabbit called Ethel has a leg injury.
Julian treats a bad-tempered goat; a horse that has cut open its hoof.
Julian performs emergency surgery on a cat, that has been shot in the head.
A dog's life hangs in the balance as it undergoes an emergency operation for a tumor.
Julian and Sarah are called out to rescue an injured swan, and a police dog needs an operation.
Julian answers an emergency call-out to help a herd of alpacas.
Julian visits Jacki Barlow's alpaca farm to investigate a strange lump.
Esme performs her first emergency caesarean, and Treacle the calf has fallen ill.
One of the Skeldale nurses helps out at a local farm during lambing season.
Julian is called out to a cow struggling to give birth to her first calf; when it becomes clear that the lives of both animals are in danger, he considers performing an emergency caesarian.
The Skeldale staff say goodbye to vet Sarah, who is leaving to have a baby; they tend to a female duck named Kevin, and a cow with a wound on its neck.
Julian helps deliver an alpaca that is in a breech position.

Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

The fourth phase of the exam takes place on Zevil Island, where the participants must battle to collect each other's ID tags; Gon and the other participants draw random numbers to determine their targets.
Gon uses the Bloodcrazy Butterflies to track Hisoka, determined to steal his tag; Leorio tries to steal back his own tag from Tonpa and runs into Kurapika.
New partners Kurapika and Leorio encounter Hisoka and try to avoid fighting; Gon uses his fishing skills to steal Hisoka's tag at a crucial moment.
Killua deals with the hunter tailing him; Gon, Leorio and Kurapika team up to take Ponzu's tag.
Gon and his fellow hunters must escape from a cave full of snakes; Netero holds interviews.
Gon and the other participants enter the final phase of the exam, a one-on-one tournament where the combatants who kill their opponents disqualify themselves; Gon fights Hanzo in the first match.

Gon becomes the first person to pass the Hunter Exam, much to his own astonishment, and Satotz explains what happened at the end of his fight with Hanzo; Hisoka manages to talk his opponents into surrender; Gittarackur goes on the warpath.
After Illumi's actions force Killua to kill, Gon vows to make things right; the group heads toward Kukuroo Mountain to save Killua from his family.
Gon and his friends, on their way to Killua's family compound, become blocked by a huge stone gate.

The gatekeeper allows Gon and his friends to stay in the servants' quarters and train to open the heavy gate; Killua withstands torture from his brother Milluki; beyond the gate, Gon faces a new challenge.
While Gon and his friends get closer to the mansion, Killua faces his father.
The family butler, Gotoh, refuses to allow Gon and his friends to see Killua unless they win a game.
Gon writes a letter to Aunt Mito recapping the Hunter exam's final phase and the hunt for Killua.
Gon and Killua arrive at Heaven's Arena and advance quickly, meeting Zushi.
Wing explains the four basic principles of Nen to Gon, Killua and Zushi.
Wing's training helps open Gon and Killua's aura nodes so they can pass through the barrier; Gon challenges Hisoka to a fight, but must meet one condition before Hisoka will agree.
Gon learns the nature of Gido's techniques but still faces a tough fight, sustaining injuries and facing Master Wing's disapproval; the Agency rejects Kurapika, but a stranger makes him an offer.
After Wing bans Gon from practicing Nen, Sky Arena hosts a revenge match between Hisoka and Kastro.
Kastro's Nen double puts Hisoka at a disadvantage, and he loses both of his arms in the fight.
Gon, now recovered, continues his Nen training; Zushi gets kidnapped; Killua fights Sadaso.
Gon and Killua fight Riehvelt and Gido; Hisoka praises Gon and offers to fight him.
Gon finally gets his fight with Hisoka.
Gon successfully lands a punch as the match with Hisoka reaches its conclusion.
Gon and Killua go to Whale Island, where Mito and her grandmother reveal Ging's past; Gon tries to open a box his father sent him.
Spurred on by Gon's father's message, Gon and Killua plan to go to Yorknew City.
Kurapika interviews for a bodyguard position that ties in with the Southern Piece Auction.
Kurapika and others battle to escape the mansion; Killua seeks information on Greed Island.
Gon and Killua gather info about Greed Island; the biggest auction in the world prepares to open.
Gon and friends try to raise money; the Phantom Troupe makes its move.
The Phantom Troupe attacks the underground auction, but their prize eludes them.
Uvogin slaughters the Mafia's pursuit, including their elite Shadow Beasts; Kurapika gets a chance to make his move against the Phantom Troupe.
Kurapika gets angry when Uvogin, his captive, makes demands; Hisoka contacts Kurapika to meet up.
Uvogin escapes and vows to get revenge on Kurapika; Kurapika must protect his employer from the Phantom Troupe after the gang discovers his location.
Kurapika and Uvogin come to blows as both combatants aim to settle a score.
Gon, Killua and Leorio, wanting to buy Greed Island, come up with a plan to make money by going to the auction market to bid low on surefire treasures; Leorio investigates the Phantom Troupe.
Gon and his friends hope to win the reward placed on the Phantom Troupe; Machi and Nobunaga search for the "chain user"; Gon and Killua receive a tip and begin shadowing the two Troupe members.
The Phantom Troupe captures Gon and Killua and interrogates them for information on the "chain user"; Killua begins to suspect the user's true identity.

The Mafia expects the Phantom Troupe to attack the rescheduled auction; the Ten Dons hire multiple assassins to deal with the Phantom Troupe; Light Nostrade sends Kurapika to join the assassins in dispatching the Troupe.
The Phantom Troupe attacks the auction; only Zeno and Silva can withstand the relentless assault.
The leader of the Phantom Troupe is dead, and Kurapika is shocked by the news; unconvinced, he tries to get a glimpse of the body; the dead bodies of the other Troupe members have been discovered.
Kurapika meets up with Gon and Killua; Kurapika reveals his Nen ability; Chrollo reads the future of Troupe members.
Chrollo uses his new ability to predict the future and predicts that Hisoka is a traitor; Kurapika and Gon plan to capture Pakunoda.

Chrollo uses the information he has on Neon to identify the location of the chain user, Kurapika; Killua is keeping an eye on the Phantom Troupe base when he is joined by Melody, who helps determine that the Troupe is headed towards Kurapika's hotel.

Gon and Killua are captives of the spiders; Kurapika, Melody, and Leorio hatch a plan to capture Chrollo and use him as leverage to force the remaining Phantom Troupe members to release Gon and Killua.
Kurapika has captured Chrollo; he offers to release Chrollo if Pakunoda brings Gon and Killua to him; however, Kurapika is unable to control his emotions in the presence of the Troupe leader.

The game Greed Island is finally on the auction block; Gon and Killua ask the purchaser to hire them as players, but they're told that their Nen is too weak; they begin to work on special abilities so they can be selected as players.
Gon and Killua want to be Greed Island players, but must demonstrate their Nen to a judge to land one of the 32 available spots.
Gon and Killua enter the world of Greed Island in hopes of finding Ging.
Gon and Killua encounter tough monsters as their quest for spell cards leads them toward Masadora; a mysterious girl named Biscuit observes the two as they fight.
When Biscuit defeats Binolt, Gon and Killua ask her to be their master.
Gon and Killua continue to improve their Nen and work together to gather more monster cards; Bisky advances them to the final stage of their training.
Gon develops a new technique based on rock-paper-scissors; Killua must leave Greed Island temporarily to take the Hunter Exam, leaving Gon and Bisky to deal with Genthru.
With Killua back, the three hunters resume collecting cards, but they still face adversaries who intend to beat them to the goal.

Josuke spots villain Angelo's Stand and tells Jotaro, who deduces the Stand can somehow enter people, so he warns Josuke to not eat or drink anything until he can reach him; Josuke witnesses the Stand go into his mother.

Angelo's Stand ability seems connected to DIO; after defeating Angelo, Jotaro tries to find the whereabouts of the bow and arrow related to the Stand; Koichi finds trouble when he walks home with Josuke.

To save Koichi, Josuke goes further into the Nijimura household; he manages to dodge an attack, but it hits Okuyasu, and Josuke offers to heal his wounds if he reveals the identity of his brother's Stand.
Josuke and Koichi defeat Keicho and continue their mission to destroy the bow and arrow; when they hear strange noises in a dark room, they enter into another fight.

Riding his bike to school, Koichi accidentally runs over a bag with a cat inside, killing it; a man appears and demands money from the regretful boy, saying that he'll use it to bury the cat, but the situation only gets worse.

Josuke and Koichi hear from Tamami that a high school student named Hazamada might also be a Stand user, so the two go to the school and investigate; Josuke checks inside Hazamada's locker and finds a strange wooden doll that attacks them.

Koichi's classmate Yukako Yamagishi asks him out, but his joy turns to worry when she unexpectedly loses her temper with him, then performs several acts of generosity for him the next day; as Yukako's obsession worsens, she does the unthinkable.

Koichi plans to escape from Yukako by having Reverb find a payphone and contact Josuke and Okuyasu, but Yukako stays one step ahead of him; as Koichi begins to lose hope, Yukako goes to the phone and something unexpected happens.

Josuke and Okuyasu visit a new Italian restaurant where the chef, Tonio, decides what the customer will eat instead of offering a menu; Tonio offers Okuyasu water that has an unexpected effect on him.

Chili Pepper shows himself to Josuke; he seems to be more powerful than Jotaro, and he can travel anywhere electricity flows; Jotaro summons Josuke, Okuyasu and Koichi and tells them a certain someone approaches Morioh.
Jotaro believes Chili Pepper will try to kill Joseph Joestar by attacking his boat, so he leaves Josuke and Koichi to defend the harbor; Josuke deals with his conflicting feelings toward Joseph.

Josuke and the others capture Akira Otoishi and safely retrieve the bow and arrow, restoring peace to Morioh, but Josuke still can't seem to get closer to the father he just met, Joseph; they discuss Josuke's mother, then discover another Stand user.

Koichi and Hazamada learn famous manga artist Rohan Kishibe lives in town, and they go to get an autograph; Rohan thrills the boys by offering a tour of his studio, but Koichi becomes frightened when he sees just how far Rohan takes his work.

Koichi sneaks into Rohan's house and finds Rohan drawing manga at an incredible speed; Rohan can't stop himself from drawing after reading about Koichi's experiences, and he attempts to take another page from Koichi by using Heaven's Door.

Jotaro unexpectedly invites Josuke to accompany him on a hunt for the rat that gained Stand abilities after Akira Otoishi shot it with the bow and arrow; they trace the rat by discovering strange evidence of the power it wields.

Koichi and Rohan discover an alley not listed on any map and decide to explore it, but when they unexpectedly find themselves back where they started with no exit in sight, Rohan suspects a Stand user trapped them.

Josuke encounters a tiny Stand holding a coin and follows it to a new Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangyu, who sends his Stand to pick up all the loose change around town; Josuke comes up with a better use for Shigekiyo's Stand.

Josuke and the others head to the bank with their lottery ticket, but the bank clerk suspects foul play since someone else's name and phone number are written on the back; when he decides to call the number, Josuke takes desperate action.

A depressed Yukako sees a mysterious shop called Salon Cinderella that creates faces to bring people fortune; she receives a new face that allows her to find love and discovers how well it works during a chance meeting with Koichi.
When Shigechi accidentally takes Kira's sandwich bag by mistake, Kira chases after him.

Becs and her boyfriend are looking for that quintessential California sea change; will they find it by the beach in Venice?

House hunters Patrick and Pol are set to see three properties in Malibu, Calif.; from modern to traditional, will these homes tick the right boxes?

Retirees Steve and Yazmin look for a luxury property in Orange County, Calif., visiting three homes in Yorba Linda, Villa Park and Santa Ana.

Orochimaru and the Sound and Sand Ninja begin their move against Hidden Leaf Village.
Pakkun, Naruto, Sakura and Shikamaru are in pursuit of Sasuke.
Orochimaru encloses the Hokage inside a barrier.
Sasuke finally catches up to Gaara, Temari and Kankuro; Kankuro escapes with Gaara, leaving Temari to face Sasuke.
The battle rages on and the Hokage resorts to a Jutsu unknown to Orochimaru.
Shino defeats Kankurō in a double-knockout; Gaara transforms into a monster to prove his existence.
Half of Gaara's body has been transformed and Sasuke continues the battle against him.
By the time Naruto and Sakura catch up, Sasuke has collapsed.
Naruto declares that he fights for his comrades but Gaara contends he fights only for himself.
Naruto is helpless against Gaara's strength.
Gaara employs his Playing Possum Jutsu, which allows the Sand Spirit within him, Shukaku, to display its true power.
With every ounce of their power, Gaara and Naruto continue to fight; determined to protect Sakura, Naruto attacks Gaara again and again.
Orochimaru's plan to destroy the Village Hidden in the Leaves is thwarted.
Kakashi arrives just in time to help Asuma and Kurenai.
Jiraiya and Naruto are on a mission to find one of the legendary Sannin.
Sasuke rushes to the town where Naruto is staying.
Jiraiya saves Naruto, and it turns out that Itachi and the Akatsuki organization are after Naruto.
Guy takes Sasuke back to the Hidden Leaf Village and Naruto is confident he will find Tsunade.
Unable to make any further progress during his training without Jiraiya, Naruto comes up with an unorthodox idea after seeing the hotel cat.
Naruto completes the first step of his training, but the next proves extremely difficult.
Orochimaru and Kabuto appear before Tsunade and Shizune and ask her to heal Orochimaru's arm; she rejects it, Orochimaru then offers her something.
For healing his arms, Orochimaru offers to bring Tsunade's younger brother back to life; Tsunade meets Jiraiya and Naruto at the restaurant, and Naruto challenges her to a battle.
Incensed at the way Tsunade disrespects the position of Hokage, Naruto challenges her to a fight.
Naruto practices hard to win the necklace from Tsunade, who is in a dilemma over Orochimaru's offer.
Tsunade almost gives in to Orochimaru's offer before Kabuto stops her healing process; Orochimaru then learns that Tsunade has no intention of healing his arm.
Orochimaru and Kabuto call forth a giant snake.
Naruto is seriously injured by Kabuto and is on the brink of death.
Jiraiya, Tsunade and Orochimaru release their summoning jutsu and a battle begins.
Tsunade, Naruto and the others head back to the Leaf Village but stop at a town with hot springs.
Tsunade suggests to Rock Lee that he must end his ninja career because of his injuries as she goes to the hospital to heal Sasuke and Kakashi.
Lee hesitates when asked whether he will quit the path of a ninja or undergo a risky surgery.
Naruto Uzumaki is determined to develop his ninja skills.
Naruto Uzumaki is determined to develop his ninja skills.
Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura are assigned their new mission to protect a young runner, Idate; because of his distaste for ninjas, Idate always argues with Naruto.

As the race starts, members of Team Seven follow Idate to a better starting point for the boating; another ninja team is waiting to attack them and after defeating the rivals, Team Seven and Idate confront the ninja leader, Aoi.
Aoi attacks Idate while team seven tries to defeat Ame ninja; after team seven saves themselves from the rivals, they help Idate and get poisoned by Aoi; Idate struggles to finish the race.
Despite interference from Aoi, Idate continues his run; Idate still trusts no one, and it's revealed that during the Chunin Exams, Idate's older brother was the proctor who posed the tenth question.
Naruto and his teammates must guard a famous actress who harbors a hidden past.
Boss Jirocho believes Idate will win.
Shikamaru gets a promotion; Lee decides on having surgery.
Naruto and Sasuke battle; Sasuke looks for revenge against his brother.
The Sound Ninja Four show themselves to Sasuke; Sakura worries about Sasuke's Curse Mark.
Sasuke leaves the village; Tsunade calls on Shikamaru to lead a mission.
The Sound Ninja Four head for Orochimaru's lair with Sasuke.
Naruto and the others weaken while trapped in Jirobo's Earth Dome Prison.
Shikamaru and the others chase the remaining Sound while Choji faces a challenger alone.
After Choji takes the yellow pill, it looks as if he may win the battle, until Jirobo transforms into Second State, giving him immense power.
The Sound ninjas neglect to lay traps.
Neji challenges Kidomaru; Kidomaru looks for Neji's weakness.
Kidomaru makes a bow and arrow to attack Neji.
Naruto, Shikamaru, Kiba and Akamaru pursue Sasuke and the Sound ninja; Orochimaru is near death.
Akamaru tries to trap Sakon; Tayuya steadily advances on Naruto's team.
Shikamaru is determined to stop Tayuya, but she uses her Summoning Jutsu to call forth three giants; on the plains, the battle between Kimimaro and Naruto is about to begin.

Warren and the others inspect Murphytown and realize they are going to need a bigger army to extract Murphy.
Doc and Addy try to convince Lucy's family to follow them; Murphy tests 10K's allegiance.
Doc tries to find a way to communicate with Warren, but instead encounters something much more menacing.
Warren leads an attack against Murphytown to extract its smug leader.
Addy is being pummeled with whatever The Man can throw at her, and Lucy does the same to The Man.
The gang reunites and faces the biggest battle yet.
Warren's apocalyptic dream of a Black Rainbow sends the group on a mysterious new mission while fighting for their lives against unkillable MAD-Z's.
Driven by her dream of a Black Rainbow and flesh eating rain, Warren and Murphy escape Zona; Doc, 10K and Sarge are pinned down by snipers.
When Sun Mei and Red vanish, 10K and the group must decide whether to keep looking for them, or give up and press on to Newmerica.
Following Warren's dream, the team doesn't stop while crossing The Great Pile, a seemingly endless landscape of rubble and destruction.
The team is captured by an Unseen Force and enslaved in an elaborate underground facility, forced by their mysterious captors to perform a series of bizarre, dangerous tasks.
Lucy fights to save Murphy's life; Warren and the others battle a biologically modified Franken-Zombie guarding a clue to Warren's dream.
Shaken by the death of one of the team, something snaps in Murphy, and Warren is unable to stop him and the others from committing an atrocity as misplaced revenge.
Warren and the others encounter a mysterious stranger who they think is a grave robber, but they're something much more.
The group explores an abandoned TV news station and encounters news crew zombies triggering haunting flashbacks from day one.
Doc and the group are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working barber shop full of mysterious and murderous characters.
Warren's dream leads the group back to Mercy Labs where she must perform a dangerous task without knowing why.
Warren and the group must stop Zona from launching Operation Black Rainbow to cleanse the landscape of zombies and humans.
The secret of Warren's Black Rainbow dream is unlocked when they reach their final destination.
Warren recovers from the drone crash with handsome, mysterious Cooper; Doc and the others finally arrive in Newmerica, where they meet George, who is helping form the new country.
Warren must leave her new life behind and find her way to Newmerica, reuniting with Murphy and the other heroes, while discovering George is an old friend.
10K nearly loses everything as Panic and anti-Talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote.
Warren and George search for Lt. Dante, who may be part of an underground network helping Talkers flee human vigilantes.
Pacifica is bombed, and the heroes decide to follow the Talker Underground to stop whoever is behind the attacks.
Warren and the others are reunited with Addy in Limbo, an underground casino run by Murphy and his Blends that shelters Talkers on the run from Altura Militia.

As Doc explains his version of American history to George, Sketchy and Skeezy re-enact Doc's stories about the Founding Fathers; Warren and the others go to the bakery that invented bizkits in search of the secret ingredient.
The heroes arrive in the farming outpost that produces flour for biscuits and find it overrun by zombies.
Doc must spirit walk again to help save the Chief of the Water Keepers and get the water flowing to Newmerica.
Altura militiamen force Talkers to mine a hazardous waste landfill for the secret ingredient to biscuits.
With some help from an outpost of renegade hackers, Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.

Police drama about a veteran officer who escorts a rookie on his first day with the LAPD's tough inner-city narcotics unit. "Training Day" is a blistering action drama that asks the audience to decide what is necessary, what is heroic and what crosses the line in the harrowing gray zone of fighting urban crime. Does law-abiding law enforcement come at the expense of justice and public safety? If so, do we demand safe streets at any cost?

Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

During a 10-year sentence for murdering the leader of a rival South Central Los Angeles gang, Bobby Johnson (Glenn Plummer) finds religion and rehabilitation with the help of Muslim inmate Ali. Upon his release, Bobby returns home to find that his young son, Jimmie (Christian Coleman), has joined the Deuces, his old crew. Tensions rise as Bobby struggles to convince Jimmie to leave the gang that was his only family during the painful years his absent father spent behind bars.

At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

After his partner and family are killed, FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge on an assassin named Rogue (Jet Li). Rogue's return sparks a violent war between rival Asian mobsters Chang (John Lone) and Shiro (Ryo Ishibashi), while the ultimate showdown between Crawford and Rogue reveals the truth.

In this film based on actual events, black activist Medgar Evers is murdered in 1963, and much of the evidence points toward white supremacist Byron De La Beckwith. However, after two trials, De La Beckwith is acquitted twice by a jury of whites. Now, decades later in 1989, Evers' widow, Myrlie, thinks she has evidence to finally convict him. But no lawyer will touch the case except the young and brash Bobby DeLaughter.

A secretary is found dead in a White House bathroom during an international crisis, and Detective Harlan Regis is in charge of the investigation. Despite resistance from the Secret Service, Regis partners with agent Nina Chance. As political tensions rise, they learn that the crime could be part of an elaborate cover-up. Framed as traitors, the pair and Regis' partner break into the White House to expose the true culprit.
Movie, Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery

Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first.

South African smugglers find themselves being hounded and harassed by Riggs and Murtaugh, two mismatched Los Angeles police officers. However, the South Africans are protected by diplomatic immunity, and so the two are assigned to witness-protection duty in an attempt by their captain to keep his job. It is only when this witness reveals to them that he has already dealt with the smugglers that the trouble really starts.

Veteran police detective Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover) is only days away from retiring when he and his tough partner, Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson), are roped into an important internal affairs case. Working with the beautiful, no-nonsense Sergeant Lorna Cole (Rene Russo) and aided by the shifty informant Leo Getz (Joe Pesci), Murtaugh and Riggs begin to close in on a black-market weapons operation involving corrupt cop and arms dealer Jack Travis (Stuart Wilson).

When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt. Aldo Raine assembles a team of Jewish soldiers to commit violent acts of retribution against the Nazis, including the taking of their scalps. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theater owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.

Stuntman Mike is a professional body double who likes to take unsuspecting women for deadly drives in his free time. He has doctored his car for maximum impact; when Mike purposely causes wrecks, the bodies pile up while he walks away with barely a scratch. The insane Mike may be in over his head, though, when he targets a tough group of female friends, including real-life stuntwoman Zoe Bell (who served as Uma Thurman's double in "Kill Bill"), who plays herself.
Shipwrecked in a strange land, marauding Vikings must battle a band of mercenaries after kidnapping the daughter of a Scottish king.

The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.
A fallen swordsman (Clive Owen) leads a small army against a sadistic ruler to avenge his dishonored master (Morgan Freeman).

As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

When a man is found shot and dumped in the road, detectives learn how his struggle to overcome obstacles left him headed for a collision with someone on the edge.

Tinja is a 12-year-old gymnast who's desperate to please her image-obsessed mother. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, she brings its strange egg home, nestles it in her bed and nurtures it until it hatches. The creature that emerges soon becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare, plunging Tinja into a twisted reality that her mom refuses to see.
Waking nightmares, bloodthirsty spirits, demonic forces, and vengeful poltergeists visit horror upon their victims in this anthology.

Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.
A wild animal attacks six grad students on a weekend hike in the woods. One by one, they become infected with an unknown virus that turns them into bloodthirsty creatures.
After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.
A teen and his best friend endure nonstop torment from bullies at school, but that soon changes when one discovers a bloodthirsty creature that resides in a country shed.
A young couple travel to a shabby Eastern European hospital for plastic surgery. Once there, things unravel into blood and violence.
Preteen girls face a night of terror when their obsession with a disturbing online game goes too far.
Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.
A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

A man and his pregnant wife become trapped in their car when a storm buries them underneath layers of snow and ice. As supplies dwindle and temperatures plunge, the couple must battle the elements and hypothermia in a desperate fight for survival.
A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.
Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

Alma y sus hijos son asesinados en el conflicto armado de Guatemala. Treinta años después, se entabla una demanda penal contra Enrique, un general retirado que supervisó el genocidio, pero al ser absuelto viene a por él un espíritu vengativo.
Investigadores exploran eventos extraños en un barrio de Buenos Aires.
En Barcelona, un exorcista y su nieta adolescente expulsan demonios mientras tratan de eludir a miembros del culto que les acechan.

Manolo y Candela se instalan en el madrileño barrio de Malasaña, junto a sus tres hijos y el abuelo Fermín, provenientes de un pueblo. La familia llega a la capital en busca de prosperidad, pero no sospechan que en la casa que han comprado no están solos.
El grupo debe defender a Alejandría de una fuerza amenazante.

Tras el encuentro de Daryl y Lydia con Alpha, los habitantes de las comunidades enfrentadas a los Susurradores, que se aproximan a la Cumbre, tienen dos opciones: huir o pelear. Entretanto, surgen problemas entre Eugene y Stephanie.

Michonne devuelve a Virgil a la isla misteriosa de la que proviene para que se reencuentre con su familia. A cambio, Virgil promete que le entregará un arsenal que cambiará el rumbo de la guerra contra los Susurradores.
Michonne lleva a Virgil de regreso a su misteriosa isla para reunirse con su familia. A cambio, Virgil promete armas que podrían cambiar el rumbo de la Guerra de los Susurradores.

Todos, héroes y villanos, se adaptan a las consecuencias del devastador incendio que destruyó la comunidad. Eugene encabeza a un grupo que parte en busca de Stephanie, guiados por la esperanza de encontrar otra civilización.

Princesa asusta a los caballos de Eugene, Yumiko y Ezequiel, pero les promete otro medio de transporte. Mientras, Beta, en estado de delirio psicótico, guía a la horda de zombis hacia Alejandría para destruirlo todo.

Los seguidores de Beta se acercan a las puertas, y parte del grupo se impregna de sangre de zombi para intentar escapar entre la multitud de caminantes y regresar con ayuda. Sin embargo, los susurradores se mueven con cuchillos entre los zombis.

Maggie regresa, para consternación de Negan. Los desafíos que superó desde su partida han hecho que se vuelva difícil sobrevivir para ella y su hijo. Por otro lado, Daryl y Maggie luchan inesperadamente contra una amenaza invisible y desconocida.

Daryl y Carol encuentran una vieja cabaña que provoca que Daryl recuerde sus años alejados del grupo después de que Rick desapareció. Además, revive el doloroso recuerdo de encontrarse con un sobreviviente y los eventos tóxicos con Dog.

Maggie, Gabriel y Aarón buscan comida y suministros para llevarlos de regreso a Alejandría, utilizando el mapa de Maggie. En su búsqueda de una ubicación más, encuentran un escondite, pero la fe se rompe y el optimismo se resquebraja.

Eugene, Ezekiel, Yumiko y Princess son capturados y separados por los misteriosos soldados que los rodeaban en la estación ferroviaria. Princess lucha con los recuerdos de su traumático pasado y planea escapar.
Wherever your destination, traveling local or far, indoor or outdoor, you can be sure AccuWeather Weekend always has you covered.
Goes beyond the forecast to give you the how and why about stuff you wanted to ask about weather, space and science.
Two Americans (Lee Van Cleef, Jack Kelly) lead Italian commandos on a World War II mission to secure a North African oasis.
An undercover man in Rome follows a crazed mob boss (Jack Palance) to a briefcase full of millions in stolen cash.

The Civil War is over, and the South has fallen, but Col. Jonas (Joseph Cotten) has a plan to revive the Confederacy. He raids a Union Army detail and walks away with valuable treasure that he intends to put to use raising another rebel army. Jonas needs to keep the treasure safe during shipment, so he places it in a coffin and forces saloon girl Claire (Norma Bengell) to play widow. Claire is unwilling to do her part, however, and puts herself in danger by opposing the dangerous Jonas.
A kung-fu fighter avenges his relatives, slain by their gangster boss.

After a stint in prison for his first robbery attempt, during which he is badly abused, Daniel Morgan (Dennis Hopper) swears revenge on those who ruined his life. Like the outlaws of the American West, Morgan, aided by an aborigine sidekick named Billy (David Gulpilil), becomes a folk hero among the Australian people, while those in power begin to worry about the trouble he is stirring up. Soon Mad Dog Morgan is Public Enemy No. 1, but neither he nor Billy intends to go down easily.
A criminal (Helmut Berger) escapes from jail and seeks revenge against the police officer who put him there.
After tracing a strange ailment to a remote gravesite, a team of supernatural experts soon discover what happens when you mess with the wrong grave.
After a girl is assaulted, two priests must determine if she was attacked by an evil spirit or a molester.

A young boy Hee-Joon is possessed by an evil spirit. Nun Yunia tries to save him, assisted by Nun Mikaela. Priest Paul attempts medical treatment, while Priest Andrew performs an exorcism to rid Hee-Joon of the spirit.

Despite being the grandson of a famed village shaman, Dr. Cheon doesn't believe in ghosts, yet he makes a living performing fake exorcisms on camera. A mysterious client hires him for a possession case, drawing Dr. Cheon into a series of unexplainable events that challenge his beliefs and revives childhood horrors he's tried to forget.
A former serial killer who has Alzheimer's disease must protect his beloved daughter from her psychotic boyfriend.
Trained in the Soviet Union, four special agents find themselves in constant danger after a traitor sells them out.
A vengeful crime boss forms an unlikely partnership with a detective, to catch the elusive serial killer who attacked him.
In the center of Seoul, previously normal people begin attacking other citizens, leading a former athlete to play one final match against the zombies.

Since 2017, the Navy has been releasing photos and videos of unidentified aerial phenomena, and ancient astronaut theorists suggest the images are nearly identical to accounts from centuries ago.
The theory that alien technology helped ancient humans build megalithic stone structures.

When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's, a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother that she never knew about.

Suzanne catches Nick watching a rap video with a pole dancer in it and decides to show Nick that she is the best pole dancer on the block.

Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk at The Big Box Club discount super store that the family does not need. Meanwhile, Lindsey enters a speed-texting contest.

Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.
Nick and Suzanne try to attend a highly anticipated movie premiere, but when their busy schedules get in the way, both are tempted to secretly go to the movie without the other.
Nick and Suzanne have been married for about six months, and the new blended family is beginning to experience growing pains. Nick thinks the kids do not love him and will not accept him.
Marilyn's new boyfriend Paul tries to convince the Kingston-Persons family to buy into a timeshare, but they are really buying into a scam.
When Kevin enters a campaign for class president, Suzanne wants him to run a clean campaign but Terrence, the Karl Rove of school elections, is adamant that he must go negative.
Kevin takes care of a rat that ends up getting lost in the house. Tension arises between Gigi and Lindsey when one of Gigi's old boyfriends showers them with gifts and clothes.
When Nick realises he is the same age his father was when he died, he decides not to waste another minute and starts tackling a list of risky activities to accomplish before he dies.
Nick angers Suzanne when he invites Martin to an exclusive sporting event before inviting his wife.
When Lindsey decides to adopt a vegan lifestyle, Suzanne convinces Nick they should go vegan as well - a decision they soon regret when they learn the extent of Lindsey's dedication.
When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best holiday ever.

Nick notices the family is disconnected and proposes a get-together with friends and family so they have the opportunity to reconnect. Unfortunately, Nick's planning leaves out some important details, leading to chaos.
Suzanne tries to keep Nick's birthday gift a surprise by taking out a loan from Marilyn.
Nick and Suzanne consider purchasing life insurance as they feel it would be a good decision to protect their family. However, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.
Nick decides the kids need to bond with his mother and asks that they spend time together. Suzanne has a day off, but she does not know what to do, now that she has a lot of time on her hands.
Nick hesitantly attends his high school reunion, but all of his fears come true when his high school nickname haunts him throughout the event. Lindsey prepares a feast.
When Nick's colleague at the station encourages him to send Lindsey and Kevin to a private school, Nick and Suzanne look into it, only to be misled about the process.
After Kevin watches 'The Sixth Sense', he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.
A note indicates that class has been moved to the science lab. The lab is unoccupied, but Jan Di waits, not realizing that the room is filling with fumes.
Jan Di's father gets kidnapped by loan sharks, which inevitably forces Jan Di's mother to swallow her pride and plead for Madam Kang's help.
The F4 guys have moved on to college while Jan Di has entered her senior year of high school. She has not heard from Jun Pyo since he left.
Jan Di waits to hear the conclusions of F3's meeting with Jun-pyo, and can tell from their look that it was not good.
After treating Jan Di in a cruel manner, Mr. Jung prepares everything so that Jun-Pyo can visit her in Seoul. Will he be able to go without Madam Kang finding out?
Jan Di's family hears about Jun-pyo's engagement and asks her miserably if it's true.
Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan Di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she stumbles around in shock.
Jun-pyo begins seeing Jae-Kyung in a new light, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend -- or maybe a kindred spirit.
Woo-bin tries to talk some sense into Yi-jung, who is determined to drink himself into a stupor.
A bullied girl becomes friends with a new kid during a break, but when classes start up again, their new friendship is nearly ruined when the bullying continues.
At home, Jun-hee reminisces about how her mother meddled in her life, in much the same way she's interfering in Jun-pyo's now.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.
Jun-pyo begs for Jan Di to advise him not to get married.
Jun-pyo tells Jan Di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be cosseted or taken care of.
Perhaps feeling it's time to expose one truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the unknown patient's bedside; at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.
Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox once more, confirming that Yumi had taken credit for her lunch.
Just being rich isn't enough to endure the teen oppression at Shinhwa -- loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique called F4.
A wicked rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School is pregnant.
Not too eager to watch Jan Di dancing with one of his best friends, Jun Pyo exits the ballroom and ends up taking out his frustrations by the poolside.

A cutting-edge, live action/animated action adventure comedy about one white blood cell's (Chris Rock) race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus (Laurence Fishburne). Bill Murray stars as Frank, in whose body the action unfolds.

Irresponsible playboy Arthur Bach (Russell Brand) has always relied on two things to keep him out of real trouble: his great wealth and the advice of his lifelong nanny, Hobson (Helen Mirren). But now Arthur must undertake the most-expensive risk of his life. He must choose between an arranged marriage that will keep him in the money or a more-modest life with the only woman (Greta Gerwig) he has ever loved. A remake of the 1981 Oscar-winning film.
Satanic aspects of a Broadway show are reflected in the life of an actress (Laura Herrington) who is in it.

Molly McGrath is following her dreams when she quits her cushy girls track coaching position at Prescott High to become the boys' football coach at inner-city Central High. Even though she's faced with both racial and gender prejudices, she whips the team into shape, so they can compete against Prescott High in the final. All the while, Molly is also dealing with her ex-husband, Frank Needham, who is trying to get custody of their two young daughters.

When a sheik (Jamie Farr) decides to sponsor a cross-country race in hope of winning, racer J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds) enters the competition along with his friend Victor (Dom DeLuise). They aspire to claim the $1 million prize and pick up two women on the way. Meanwhile, the sheik helps Jamie Blake (Dean Martin) and Morris Fenderbaum (Sammy Davis Jr.) with an angry mob boss. But when the sheik is kidnapped, the contestants must come together to help him.

Having already stolen two from the set of three priceless Napoleon Diamonds, expert jewel thief Max Burdett (Pierce Brosnan) decides to retire on a tropical island with his girlfriend and partner-in-crime, Lola (Salma Hayek). Fate intervenes, however, when Max discovers the third and final diamond is sitting on a docked cruise ship on his very island. It should be a simple job, but FBI agent Stan Lloyd (Woody Harrelson) shows up to make sure Max doesn't get any ideas.

Former sportswriter Andy Farmer and his secretly aspiring author wife, Elizabeth, move to a small farm in Vermont, so Andy can focus on writing a novel. They quickly realize that the locals are not as welcoming as they'd like and that the farm is more distracting than inspiring. Having trouble with his manuscript, and with his marriage on the rocks, Andy is forced to take hilariously drastic measures in an attempt to get his life back on track.
The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

Disaster movie sequel following two groups of adventurers as they race to salvage a doomed ship's treasure hours after it has been crippled by a tidal wave. When the gold-diggers enter the overturned liner through a hole cut by the coastguard they discover more survivors still trapped on board and struggle to carry out their plans before the ocean finally claims the wrecked vessel.

Winslow Lowry (Anthony Geary) is a greedy man determined to get his hands on the fortune of his ailing and very wealthy uncle, Albert Dennison (Ralph Bellamy). As a way to hasten Uncle Albert's death, Winslow puts him in the care of three hapless orderlies -- Buffy, Markie and Kool, also known as the Fat Boys (The Fat Boys) -- but their jolly dispositions actually make the elderly man feel better. When Winslow steps up his devious efforts, can the trio stop him?

When journalist Guy Hamilton (Mel Gibson) arrives in Jakarta, Indonesia, he has difficulty making contacts. He forms a friendship with dwarf photographer Billy Kwan (Linda Hunt), through whom he meets British diplomat Jill Bryant (Sigourney Weaver). Bryant falls for Hamilton, and she gives him key information about an approaching Communist uprising. As the city becomes more dangerous, Hamilton stays to pursue the story. However, he faces more threats as he gets closer to the government.

Nelson Moss (Keanu Reeves) and Sara Deever (Charlize Theron) have nothing in common except an hour spent in DMV hell. Intrigued by each other, but not quite ready to commit, they settle on a rather unconventional courtship: a one-month trial, after which they'll go their separate ways. No expectations. No pressure. No strings attached. What neither of them counts on is falling in love.

College student Wyatt (Paul Rudd) is convinced that his hometown girlfriend, Kimberly (Christine Taylor), is cheating on him. Disconsolate at a strip club, he nonetheless tries to defend the honor of Ivy (Reese Witherspoon), one of the dancers, who befriends him for his gesture. Ivy convinces Wyatt that he should send Kimberly a vicious breakup letter, which he does, by express mail. When he has second thoughts, he and Ivy hit the road to retrieve the note before it reaches its destination.
Jonathan y Mark le dan una lección a Laurie, una joven actriz cuya fama la está convirtiendo en una mala persona, afectando a su familia y robándole su infancia.
Jonathan debe reunir a los vecinos de Helen para que se unan y ayuden a salvar sus casas de unos promotores inmobiliarios que quieren desalojarlos.

Harry, todavía en duelo por la pérdida de su esposa, es puesto en un hogar de ancianos, pero su visión de la vida cambia cuando tiene la oportunidad de cumplir el mayor deseo de su esposa: visitar Hollywood.

La hija de un entrenador de caballos y el hijo de un ranchero se conocen en un entrenamiento y nace una atracción entre ellos. Jonathan y Mark tienen que actuar de cupido para unirlos, a pesar de que él ya está comprometido.
Garth y Lizzy se fugan juntos y se casan. Ella descubre que tiene cáncer, pero no quiere contárselo a Garth hasta no saber sus posibilidades de sobrevivir.

Jonathan Smith ayuda a los ancianos de un asilo a recuperar su vitalidad, al ofrecer gratis sus servicios de jardinería. Además, dos hermanos, uno de ellos alcohólico, también requieren de la gentileza de Jonathan.
Mark duda de Jonathan y es hostil con él. Por ese motivo, Jonathan decide revelarle a Mark su condición de ángel. Los ancianos se sienten destrozados por la noticia de la posible venta del asilo.

Jonathan acude al auxilio de una madre afligida por la enfermedad terminal de su pequeño hijo, Aitor, que desea tocar la luna. Por otro lado, Mark se encuentra con un niño problemático al que intenta darle una segunda oportunidad.

Jonathan y Mark buscan trabajo como entrenadores de boxeo para poder ayudar a jóvenes llenos de ira. Mientras tanto, reaparece Morton Clay, también conocido como "el jinete enmascarado", acompañado de sus amigos.

Jonathan se encuentra con Sara, una joven cantante que desea saber más sobre su madre muerta, pero a su padre no le gusta hablar de ella. Sin embargo, la vida de Sara puede cambiar cuando un secreto sale a la luz.
Un atleta llamado Dick queda postrado en una silla de ruedas luego de un terrible accidente. El joven necesita la ayuda de Mark y Jonathan, pero también de Eleanor.

Gracias a la ayuda de Jonathan, un estudiante de secundaria que queda postrado luego de un accidente recupera su voluntad de vivir. Sin embargo, su furia reaparece cuando descubre que el hombre que lo atropelló está más cerca de lo que cree.
Un anciano excéntrico que dice ser el Rey Arturo y su codicioso hijo reciben la ayuda de Jonathan y Mark. Además, asisten a una mujer que va a perder sus tierras por culpa del ambicioso heredero.
Un famoso actor contrata a Jonathan y a Mark para que cuiden a sus dos hijos. Sin embargo, los niños sienten mucho la ausencia de su padre.
Jonathan y Mark acuden al llamado de un par de ancianos que buscan la ayuda de un ángel para poder hacer una película que llegue al corazón de muchas personas.

Un hombre que estuvo en Vietnam descubre que tiene una hija llamada Nu Yen, que decide irse a vivir a Estados Unidos con él y su familia. Su hijo Brad es la única persona que no está contenta con esta situación, por lo que Jonathan y Mark le ayudan.

Mark y Jonathan ayudan a Barry, un heredero que debe hacerse cargo del hotel de su padre. Al mismo tiempo, debe decidir entre dos mujeres que lo desean: una antigua compañera de clase, y una mujer que trabaja en el hotel.

La expansión de un negocio de autos amenaza a un orfanato justo en plena Navidad. Jonathan y Mark deben hacer comprender al dueño del negocio cuál es el significado de estas fiestas para que no lleve a cabo sus planes.
Jonathan y Mark van a una cafetería para desayunar y son molestados por ser forasteros. Ambos investigan la desaparición de un viejo amigo de Mark. Jonathan encuentra el auto de Charly enterrado.

Jonathan conoce a Liby, de la que se termina enamorando. Al mismo tiempo, Earl, otro chico interesado en Liby, lleva tiempo tratando de conquistarla, por lo que Jonathan debe tomar una decisión difícil.
Mark tiene un accidente automovilístico y queda herido. Jonathan, entonces, lo hace viajar en el tiempo para que pueda salvar a su abuelo y recuperar las tierras de su familia.
Una estrella de baloncesto de la universidad lucha diariamente con su analfabetismo para poder lograr ser becado. Sin embargo, una enfermedad del corazón le impide llevar a cabo sus sueños.
Una mujer moribunda intenta reconciliarse con su severo padre para que su hija ilegítima pueda vivir en un lugar seguro.
La guía de Jonathan ayuda en una conexión amorosa entre Diana, la prima de Mark, y Scotty, un divertido e interesante abogado con tetraplejía.
Jonathan decide hacerse pasar por un hombre millonario, despiadado y soberbio, y por un mendigo amable al que le queda poco tiempo de vida.

Esta serie dramática representa en cada capítulo de una hora historias distintas y reales sobre mujeres mexicanas que atraviesan diferentes vicisitudes. Las experiencias de estas mujeres tratan de temas censurados por la sociedad y por lo tanto ellas los enfrentan en silencio, algunas de las situaciones que se examinan son: el abuso infantil, el embarazo no deseado, asesinatos, la pornografía y la violencia familiar entre otras. Al final de cada episodio se muestra una lista de centros o agencias de ayuda para personas que se sientan identificadas con los casos específicos, se hace un llamado para que busquen ayuda y rompan su silencio.
Un espacio en el que se tocan temas controversiales, de forma abierta y sin censura como sexo, infidelidad, identidad de género, salud mental, conductas delictivas, o fractura familiar.

La serie cuenta, en cada capítulo, una historia diferente con personajes nuevos. El eje central de las historias es el transporte público, ya que todas ellas suceden dentro de alguno de los medios de traslado del país.

La serie de misterio y espanto, relata leyendas populares escalofriantes que aterrorizan hasta los más valientes. El programa cuenta estas historias y trata en lo posible de grabar en las localidades, algunas de estas son lugares históricos en que supuestamente las leyendas sucedieron o visita lugares parecidos para así tratar de reflejar la historia original y hacerla tan parecida como sea posible. Si quiere dormir con la luz prendida observe este programa que lo mantendrá en suspenso y aterrorizado.
