Bloody Mary's made with real blood, whole roasted pigeons, donuts topped with chicken and milkshakes made with bacon.
Andrew tastes everything from southern staples like smoked baloney sandwiches, deep-fried chicken livers, and pork rinds, to new spins on old staples.
Andrew Zimmern goes deep into the interior of Florida and discovers that people in the rural areas are still living off the land and eating much like their ancestors did.
Fresh snakehead pulled from the Potomac; pupusas at a Salvadoran restaurant; peanut butter sandwiches made with foie gras.
Rocky Mountain oysters at a ballpark; yak and elk served at an historic restaurant; pheasant cooked outside.
Andrew Zimmern finds out that there's a lot more than meat and potatoes on the table in Iowa; pork brains with spring onion kimchi; a stew made from a sheep's head.
Andrew Zimmern gets a whole new taste of Alaska's Inside Passage. Fresh sea cucumbers; salmon eggs; fish heads.
Science behind what makes milk taste better; a traditional Serbian casserole made with lamb organs; emu testicles.
A fish dish made with ambergris; charcuterie that includes duck heart pate; a soup that smells like a dead body.
Beef tongue sandwiches; Korean soul foods that include boiled pig stomach and blood sausage; traditional bay foods like barbecued muskrat and grilled eel.
Andrew Zimmern makes a trip to the Ozarks where people are still living off the land and making the most of it by combining old traditions with new techniques.
Andrew visits northern California where people are reinventing the way they look at food. Grilled dove hearts; barf flavored jelly beans; monkey face eel.
Elk heart tartar with a raw turkey egg; bourbon smoked cherries and bone marrow; goose liver with cacao.
Andrew finds out that some of the best foods in LA are hiding deep inside city neighborhoods; pig head tamales; steamed chicken embryo.
Andrew wants to find out what Hawaiians really like to eat; dried octopus bile sac; crispy pork intestine;and a traditional take on a raw fish salad that includes the eyeballs.
Andrew visits the forgotten Gulf shore where people strive to preserve their own unique way of life; stingray tacos; pan fried duck testicles; nutria stew.
A Pakistani kebab joint with a dish made out of goat liver and brains; a Tibetan place with soup made from yak meat; buffalo chicken feet with maple syrup.
A Chinese style noodle bowl made with frog legs and pig skin; sautéed rabbit offal and goat head soup.
Andrew visits Rhode Island where old traditions meet the experimental to create clam cakes and monkfish liver mousse.
Andrew visits Louisville, KY, when he tastes its unique foods; barbecued sheep meat, pork brain sandwiches and burgoo, a hunter's stew made with squirrel.
From social media to AI, advertising has changed dramatically in a short time. Host Raja Rajamannar sits down with marketing leaders to learn how they cut through the noise to reach consumers.
Athletic Brewing helped move non-alcoholic beer into the mainstream. CEO Bill Shufelt explains how it paired a reinvented product with the concepts of craft and wellness.
Asmita Dubey, L'Oréal's global chief digital and marketing officer, unpacks how the century-old brand is adapting to the influencer economy and beauty technology.
From immersive experiences to [LIVE]-streaming, National Women's Soccer League Chief Marketing and Commercial Officer Julie Haddon discusses the growing opportunities for women's professional sports.
Jason Kelly follows Pierre Gasly from Alpine Headquarters to a Paris photo shoot to get a firsthand look at how the business of being a 🏎️ [F1] Formula One driver goes far beyond the track.
Sports personalities share their perspectives and discuss various subjects like the ever-evolving world of business, diversity in elite competitions and the rise of esports.
Mathematician Hannah Fry explores emerging technology, science, and people who are on the edge of the most transformative breakthroughs.

Emily Chang meets some of the world's most advanced and intelligent robots and speculates if the creation of a synthetic species with human-like intelligence will improve the human experience or cause its downfall.
Francine Lacqua interviews some of the most influential people to know about their story and their vision for the future.
High-profile journalist Emily Chang takes a look into the intersection of culture, tech, entertainment, and business.

The best journalists all over the world present immersive coverage of relevant news stories. Each story is extensively researched and is recounted by acclaimed journalists as well as the people who are living the story.
Ji Chaoqun dedicates himself to engineering, heading to study in the US; China's spy agency makes Ji Chaoqun a lucrative offer, changing his life forever.
Gold builds South Africa, but mining kills some who dig for it. In Stilfontein, a disaster that traps miners underground reveals how a quest for gold becomes a story of hunger, survival and death.
A housing crisis is revived as debt collectors bring back loans that were once thought cancelled. Scheming tactics and outdated laws bring about devastation for millions of Americans.

Police and Elly's animals converge on the Clampett estate when Pearl starts giving yodeling lessons.

Granny's plan to stop Pearl's yodeling backfires when the police she called find her illegal still.
Jed's bloodhound Duke takes on the role of matchmaker for his master and a glamorous woman from France.
A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park and the Hollywood Freeway.
Jed is promoted to the position of bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot.
An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed's ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.
Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.
Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.
Grannie manages to chase away an IRS agent with a shotgun, prompting a story from Mr. Drysdale about how the family came to live in Beverly Hills in the first place.
Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.
Love blooms again for Jed when Mlle. Denise returns from Paris to herald the arrival of a litter of poodles.
The board chairman of Drysdale's bank is determined to meet Jed Clampett, the bank's financial wizard.
Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious auto accident.
Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.
The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.
Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but the doctor still wants to see Grannie; her love potion for Pearl misfires, leaving Twombly confused.
The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.
Jed takes over Drysdale's job for one afternoon and wins him the Banker of the Year title; Drysdale accidentally uses the wrong speech for his conference, and a new teller makes an impact.
One of Jethro's school friends spends a day at the Clampett mansion, and the hillbillies show the over-protected boy how to have fun.
Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.
To humor Granny, Jed fakes illness so that she can resume the doctoring that brought her fame in the hills.
Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.
Granny's neighbors try to stop her when she attempts to create a vegetable garden in the front yard of the mansion grounds.
A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.

En el segundo tiempo del partido Furano empata el marcador. Tsubasa, pese a estar lesionado y empeorar con cada minuto que pasa, arriesga todo e intenta hacer su tiro con efecto. Matsuyama está a la expectativa para impedirlo.

La muy esperada final del Torneo Nacional ha llegado y Tsubasa espera recuperarse de su lesión para jugar con toda su capacidad contra el Toho. Por su parte, Hyuga le pide al entrenador Kitazume que le permita jugar este partido tan importante.
En los primeros cinco minutos del partido la tensión en la cancha se puede cortar con un cuchillo. Ambos capitanes están empeñados en usar sus técnicas especiales para lograr la victoria.

A pesar de la disciplina de Nankatsu, el equipo Toho impone su dominio con dos goles de diferencia, cortesía de su capitán y su poderoso tiro del tigre. Tsubasa, frustrado por su lesión, no sabe cómo contrarrestarlo.
A pesar de las advertencias del médico, Tsubasa está decidido a permanecer en el campo para ayudar a sus compañeros en la batalla contra el equipo de Toho.
Continúa la final entre el Nankatsu y el Toho, que empatan 3-3. La presión hace que ambos equipos cometan errores y, en el fervor del partido, Takasugi comete una falta.
Evento estelar: Nicklaus Flaz (12-2-0) vs. Alfredo Escárcega Jr. (15-1-1) y Katsuma Akitsugi (10-0-0) vs. Eduardo Ramírez (22-3-3).

Evento estelar: Chris Colbert vs. Omar Salcido. Evento coestelar: Tsendbataar Erdenebat vs. Frency Fortunato; Najee López vs. Ismael Ocles; David Navarro vs. Mykell Gamble.

Ramón Cárdenas (25-1, 14 KO) se enfrenta a Bryan Acosta (20-0, 8 KO) en un combate peso supergallo. En la coestelar: Lester Martínez se enfrenta a Joeshon James en una pelea peso supermediano. Desde el Boeing Center, en San Antonio.
Yuri Orlov es un traficante de armas ruso que recorre los países en guerra mientras intenta eludir la persecución de un agente de la Interpol.
Una pareja inglesa viaja con unos amigos a España para conocer su nueva propiedad campestre y descubren a una niña recluida que tiene sus manos deformes.

Raiden es un afortunado caballero al que su maestro Bartok nombra heredero. Sin embargo, su felicidad desaparece cuando el emisario del emperador Mott lo obliga a decapitar a su mentor. Para evitarlo, Raiden terminará desterrando a Bartok y a su corte de guerreros.

John Alexander, un sicario contratado para asesinar a un narcotraficante afgano en Odessa, Ucrania, deja en segundo plano su misión para salvar a una chica que está siendo explotada por una mafia dedicada a la trata de personas.
Un estudiante de Nueva York se convierte en el azote de Londres después de ser mordido por una bestia en los páramos.
Estudiantes vacacionistas se convierten en la presa de un mortífero cocodrilo después de que destruyeron su nido.
Una experta en tiburones traumatizada debe luchar con sus propios temores para ayudar a un hombre de negocios a bucear en una sección peligrosa conocida como el "callejón de los tiburones".
Mattie Carver experimenta alucinaciones auditivas y visuales mientras es testigo del colapso espacio-temporal.
Un explorador se embarca, junto con su padre y su novia, en una expedición para encontrar la Ciudad Dorada, un lugar que esconde misteriosas criaturas.
Estudiantes de preparatoria desplazados por el huracán Katrina forman un equipo de baloncesto.
Dos ladrones son atrapados por el FBI y para evitar ir a prisión deberán trabajar para el gobierno, en la Agencia de Fuerzas Especiales para el Retorno de Objetos Robados.
Un romance tormentoso entre una mujer y un apuesto extraño se convierte en una red de engaño, desconfianza y violencia a bordo de un yate.
Cansado de lidiar ante la continua negatividad de su mujer, un esposo contrata a un hombre para que la seduzca y así poder terminar su matrimonio.
Dos artistas callejeros son contratados para realizar una broma de mal gusto a un empresario. Lo que ellos no saben, es que en realidad les han tendido una trampa.
El Centro de Inteligencia Nacional despliega un operativo para atrapar a José Vicente Solís Armenta, más conocido como El Capo. El narco huye, ingeniosamente, con su amante y su esposa.
Las cosas en el búnker se ponen tensas; afuera, los hijos de Guadalupe y José Vicente buscan la manera de ayudarlos a huir y esquivar a las autoridades.
Una llamada logra distraer a la policía y es también una llamada la que logra salvarlos antes de que vuelva el operativo.
Para algunos, Pablo Escobar es sinónimo de muerte y destrucción; para su familia, fue un hombre ejemplar, un buen padre, hijo, tío, hermano y esposo.
En un penal de máxima seguridad se dan a la fuga los hombres más peligrosos y, con tal de no ser capturados, dejan a su paso una terrible masacre.
Un policía ejemplar está bajo la mira de la mafia y al no poder atraparlo dicha organización asesina a su hermano.

El misterioso pasado de Robert McCall resurge cuando unos matones asesinan a Susan Plummer, su mejor amiga y excolega. Sediento de venganza, McCall debe enfrentarse a un grupo de asesinos expertos que no se detendrán hasta acabar con él.
Mireles y sus sicarios están dispuestos a cumplir su misión defendiendo la plaza a sangre y fuego en contra de su acérrimo enemigo el Inge.
La geografía del narcotráfico y la radiografía de la adicción en Estados Unidos, donde está el mayor número de adictos a las drogas.
Houston, nervioso, logra engañar a la policía para impedir que entren y lo descubran. Julián recibe una llamada que le advierte que si no entrega la memoria, las asesinarán.

Julián le tiende una trampa a Houston, pero el plan fracasa y él escapa con un rehén. Mariana enfrenta a Cicatriz y, ante la propuesta de Ricardo, la duda se apodera de ella.
Drama, Crime drama, Thriller, Action, Romance
Esperanza le dice a Houston que es un asesino y que nunca le perdonará haberla secuestrado. Él hace caso omiso y sigue con su teatro de amor. El detective libera a Julián y a Micaela.

Los nietos de Conchita descubren que guarda droga en su cuarto y ella les dice que es para uso medicinal. Rafael le dice a su abogado que quiere ver a Domingo encerrado en una cárcel o muerto.
Sofía le advierte a Domingo que si le dan cadena perpetua por matar a Rogelio, no lo esperará. Mercurio le pide a Julia que le cuente lo que pasó a Salomón para que le dé dinero de su cuenta.
Dylan le pide a Rebeca que ponga cámaras en casa de Alejandro Méndez. Por su parte, Camilo le advierte a Mercurio que tiene que estar armado en la cárcel para sobrevivir.

La historia del capitán Carlos Camacho Espíritu, un inmigrante que halló el éxito al dejar su país para convertirse en uno de los primeros locutores de radio en tocar la música regional mexicana en una estación radial de Los Ángeles en EE.UU.
Monsalve obliga a Lucía a llamar a su madre y decirle que está en una bodega. Le envía las coordenadas, pero todo es una trampa. Manuel pide ayuda. Alicia ve a la niña, pero no puede acercarse.
Alicia decide entregarse para que su hija recupere la libertad, y Monsalve se la lleva secuestrada. Smith está cansado de que no se sigan sus órdenes. Altagracia recibe una llamada de Manuel.
Los hombres de Suescún capturan a Monsalve y Alicia. Altagracia y Manuel los siguen. Sandoval quiere que Alicia lo mate y que todo quede grabado. Ella se niega, pero tiene con qué amenazarla.
Escobar teme por su vida, pues su rostro aparece en la televisión como uno de los más buscados. Se refugia en una casa secreta. Los Pepes y el gobierno planean acabar con los aliados de Pablo.
Los Castaños intentan impedir la salida del país de la familia de Escobar. Pablo llama a la prensa al aeropuerto para evitar que los asesinen. Carlos se enamora de una joven y quiere casarse.
Victoria y sus hijos salen ilesos de un fuerte tiroteo, pero la familia de los Castaños no tiene la misma suerte. Vicente y Catalina resultan heridos por atentados. Escobar escapa de nuevo.

La seductora agente secreto Helena regresa para cumplir una nueva misión: debe infiltrarse en el círculo privado de un científico genial, de quien sospechan que ha desarrollado un virus altamente mortal y contagioso.
Una manera más relajada de comenzar el día.

Ricardo Soto está casado con Miranda Robles, una mujer guapa con una afortunada posición social. Su esposo aprovechará esta situación para ponerle el cuerno con una jovencita mucho menor que él, sin recordar que el que ríe al último, ríe mejor.
Cata termina con su novio y supone que volverá de rodillas, rogando casarse con ella. Pero tiempo después lo encuentra siendo el hombre perfecto y a punto de casarse con otra.
Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.
Elena es una escurridiza ladrona y artista del disfraz. Al verse perseguida por la policía, se disfraza de monja y se refugia en un convento, donde seguirá cometiendo imprudencias.

Jackie es una joven que disfruta de ayudar a los más necesitados, pero su esposo Samuel no comparte este sentimiento. Un trágico accidente lo deja en coma y entonces ella decide seguir su vida y volverse a enamorar.

Dos jóvenes se reencuentran en otra vida. Alejandro reconoce a Yolanda, quien pertenece a una extraña familia y a la que él culpa de la muerte de su padre. Alejandro busca el secreto detrás de la muerte de su padre.

Christine, un duende de Santa, se pregunta si podría haber más en la vida que la fabricación de juguetes en el Polo Norte y consigue un trabajo durante las vacaciones, ayudando a una familia en la planificación de un evento de caridad.
Una mujer viaja a un castillo irlandés después de que su compromiso termina una semana antes de su boda.
Después de heredar la mitad del viñedo de su tío, una mujer debe trabajar con el copropietario durante tres semanas o arriesgarse a perder la tierra.
Tras descubrir que su difunto padre estuvo casado con alguien más, una mujer decide encontrar a su exesposa.
Colocado en el programa de protección de testigos, un mafioso reformado se enamora de su vecina y ayuda a su hija a hornear las famosas galletas de las Girls Scouts.
Una prepotente directora de teatro tiene una nueva perspectiva sobre la vida cuando ella toma un concierto en una pequeña ciudad.
Una jinete lucha para poder caminar nuevamente cuando un terrible accidente a caballo la deja paralizada.
Un joven de 15 años de edad lucha por mantener juntos a sus hermanos después de la muerte de su madre.
Los padres enfrentan la locura y la disminución de los fondos después de que sus tres hijas se mudan a su hogar y luego anuncian sus bodas.
Un hombre vuelve a su casa y se llena de recuerdos, a la vez que intenta convencer a su madre de vender la propiedad.
Una mujer joven intenta volver a conectarse con el operador de la llamada de emergencia que la ayudó después de un accidente de auto.
Ellie y Martín son dos recién casados que han perdido sus respectivos trabajos y tienen que irse a vivir a casa de los padres de ella.
Una editora de libros busca al Sr. Perfecto en Los Ángeles, mientras trabaja para un autor muy exigente.
Una mujer (Jennifer Esposito) enumera las cualidades de su hombre perfecto, luego se enamora de un chico (David Sutcliffe) que no cumple ninguno de sus criterios.
Al quedarse repentinamente sin trabajo, una mujer toma una posición como niñera para un guapo padre adoptivo.
Los fantasmas de las Navidades pasadas, presentes y futuras visitan a una desagradable presentadora televisión y le dan la oportunidad de encontrar algo genuino en el espíritu navideño.
En el puerto de Mar del Plata durante la guerra de las Malvinas, un pescador se pierde en un lugar llamado "La Campana", donde el tiempo transcurre muy diferente al tiempo real.
Una pareja de "reality TV" llega a la habitación 207 para sus vacaciones, pero pronto aparece un televisor extraño en la habitación y comienza su secreto más oscuro.
Después de conocer a una chica extraña, Gamal es transportado a la batalla de Vittorio Veneto para presenciar la historia de Alfred Lorenzo, el propietario original del hotel.
Siete historias de terror nacidas en Guadalajara, México, que helarán la sangre del más valiente.

Lucía vive en una cabaña en medio de un bosque con su abuela, una misteriosa anciana muda. Lucía llegó a la inhóspita casa escapando de El Monje Negro, el oscuro y despiadado líder de una banda y padre del hijo que espera.

Un antiguo y poderoso ser de la selva, que lleva encerrado más de 30 años dentro de un pabellón de un hospital, ha sido liberado. Ahora buscará poseer los cuerpos de quienes encuentre en su camino. Una joven es poseída y desatará el terror en el lugar. Su madre, una doctora escéptica, intentará luchar para entender lo que está pasando y salvar a su hija de esta pesadilla.
Un malentendido lleva al secuestro de la hija (Marta Etura) de un viudo (Juan Diego) y a la muerte de un granjero (Celso Bugallo) inepto.

En un bosque, emerge, desnudo y bañado en sangre, Elías, sin un solo recuerdo de lo que le ha ocurrido a él y a sus tres amigos desaparecidos. Su hermano, un agente de policía local, es el único que puede ayudarlo a resolver el enigma y exculparlo.

Dos jóvenes parejas han elegido un nuevo sitio para su borrachera del sábado noche: una casa rural abandonada con una leyenda. Hace 45 años, una joven, mentalmente discapacitada, fue seducida y violada por soldados, estrangulada y luego quemada.
Dannenberg vive solo en una casa en medio del campo. Una tarde ve a lo lejos a dos personas que se acercan y las cosas de aquí en adelante se vuelven imprevisibles.

El dueño de una enorme casa de campo, situada en el pueblo de Barrancas, tiene fama de pagar mal a sus empleados; por lo que cuando el cuidador de la casa no aparece, todos piensan que se fue. Mario, el sobrino del dueño, es enviado de imprevisto a pagar los servicios y entregar la casa a un nuevo cuidador. Mario se aprovecha de la situación para invitar, sin permiso, a la chica que le gusta y a algunos amigos de la universidad. Lo que Mario no sabe, es el peligro que corre.

Martín y su familia son unos emigrantes españoles que regresaron a Madrid en 1968 tras pasar varios años trabajando en Suiza. Ahora, en 1974, parten de nuevo hacia Suiza por decisión de su hijo Pablo, un joven de dieciocho años con ganas de vivir aventuras y una mentalidad muy diferente a la de la generación predecesora.

El mundo de Andy cambia totalmente cuando su madre tiene un accidente. Sin nadie que lo cuide, es llevado a Cuernavaca, a la casa de su lejana abuela paterna. Mientras su madre se debate entre la vida y la muerte, el niño se enfrentará al rechazo de su abuela, al mundo seductor y peligroso del hijo del jardinero y a la búsqueda de su padre.

Adrián abandona las montañas del sur argentino y viaja a Buenos Aires para vengar la muerte de su esposa. La ciudad, bajo su mirada esquizoide, es el escenario de un juego de caza, plagado de violencia.

Una disputa por alcanzar el poder dentro de la federación de transportes más importante del país deja a Carmen en medio de una guerra que involucra la vida de su hija. Carmen usa la única arma a su disposición para salvarse y lograr huir.

Un joven de extracción humilde se ve obligado a dejar atrás su Colombia natal y cruzar la frontera hacia los Estados Unidos. Una vez allí su primo le introduce a un mundo de negocios ilícitos, de enredos y traiciones.

A consecuencia de sus problemas con el alcohol y las drogas, la Justicia le retiró a Sara la custodia de su hija cuando esta tenía cuatro años. Cinco años después, un juez decide devolver la niña a Sara, quien rehizo su vida y tiene trabajo estable.
La historia del encuentro amoroso puede darse en muchas maneras en diversas parejas. Es una reflexión sobre la reproducción, la fidelidad y el amor.
Un conductor de camión decide llevar a su hijo es su próximo viaje para mostrarle el océano y se mete en problemas.

Samuel, un joven campesino dominicano, se enfrenta a la hostilidad e injusticia de la dictadura de Trujillo. Un enfrentamiento con un grupo de guardias da muerte involuntaria a uno de sus miembros, por lo que huirá dejando a su familia.

La construcción de un hotel en una localidad del noroeste de Argentina altera la vida de los habitantes del municipio, pero especialmente trastoca la realidad de Isabel, una adolescente muy afectada por el choque cultural generado por la obra.

Careless American military personnel dump chemicals into South Korea's Han River. Several years later, a creature emerges from the tainted waters and sinks its ravenous jaws into local residents. When the creature abducts their daughter (Go Ah-sung), a vendor (Song Kang-ho) and his family decide that they are the only ones who can save her.
A satanic group lures a man to a party in order to murder him.

Members (Danny Dyer, Laura Harris, Tim McInnerny) of the Palisades Defense Corp. sales group arrive in Europe for a team-building exercise. A fallen tree blocks the route, and they must hike to their destination. However, a psychotic killer lurks in the woods, and he has a horrible fate in mind for each of the co-workers.
Blood begins to spill soon after the daughter (Allie MacDonald) of a Broadway diva wins the lead in the summer showcase at a performing-arts camp.

Seeking new inspiration and a fresh start, married musicians Darcy and Daphne move to the Welsh countryside to finish their new record. While collecting audio samples, Darcy inadvertently creates a field recording of a mysterious sound never before heard by human ears. The discovery soon renews Daphne's creative energy, but as the echoes of her music bleed into the surrounding landscape, ancient and malevolent woodland forces are disturbed.
A young woman with a dark past makes her vows to enter the nun hood and begins having premonitions of murders that seem to be related to the paintings of Caravaggio.
A honeymooning bride (Rose Leslie) goes sleepwalking into the woods surrounding a secluded cabin. When she returns she looks the same, but something about her is frighteningly different.

A Native American teenager and his grandmother resurrect an ancient demon to protect their family from backwoods meth dealers. However, they soon discover that the creature's lust for killing can't be controlled.
Astronauts (Liev Schreiber, Elias Koteas, Romola Garai) on Mars contend with a microbe that turns those it infects into zombielike killers.
Terror awaits some friends after they meet a dangerous young woman from a Los Angeles cult.
Hoping for peace and solitude, a homeless woman breaks into an unoccupied mansion but soon discovers she is not alone.
Members of a deranged family use the world's scariest maze to hunt unsuspecting teens with perfect skin.
A deranged family holds a woman and dozens of others captive to harvest their skin for a breakthrough cream.
A plant created via genetic engineering appears to produce curious changes in the people and animals it comes into contact with.
An unemployed man who spends his days hiding from his nagging wife in his allotment shed faces a difficult decision when a zombie apocalypse strikes his neighborhood.
The artistry and creativity that bring Cirque du Soleil performances to life.
Fan-favorite Cirque du Soleil songs from shows like Alegria, Kooza, Mystere and more.
Following the cast and crew of KURIOS on tour and what hides in their Cabinet of Curiosities.

When a British TV show becomes popular, an American network often makes its own version of the show. In this case, Lifetime is importing this series that pits four amateur cooks against one another as they compete for a cash prize. Each contestant prepares a meal for a dinner party -- with a unique theme, location and menu -- for the other competitors, who critique and score the cook. The contestant who earns the most points for his or her party wins the title of the host with the most and, more importantly, the money. Radio personality Todd Pettengill narrates the series.
Dave, Caroline and Tom try to serve up their best British meals; Andrea goes with a more oriental-inspired approach.

Eric says his 14-year-old sister is out of control and headed down the path of self-destruction; Lesley is convinced that his wife is cheating on him.

Shawntia has more than $13,000 worth of debt because of her husband Ian's gambling obsession; Mercedes is pregnant and all alone after kicking her husband, Haywood, out of the house because, during an argument, she says, he bit her.
Dytazia wants to know if her mother tried to sell her for drugs; a young boy dies while in the care of a relative; Kristie wants to know who her biological father is.

Marshall and his wife find out if he has a daughter; Keonie is fed up with being fat-shamed and controlled by his verbally abusive grandmother, who says that she's always had his back and did everything she could to raise him.

Sisters Jazmine, Jenny and Janey hope they can repair the scar tissue from some very deep wounds; Rani is livid and can't seem to get the image of her boyfriend, Chris, with another woman out of her mind.

Brandon believes that wife Tiffany is cheating on him with several men; Mark raised Markeya and her siblings as if they were his own, but after their grandmother passed away, he noticed a change for the worse in their behavior toward him.

Detective Kiera Cameron is a cop from the year 2077 who was raised to rely on technology more than anything else, even herself. Now she and a group of deadly criminals called Liber8 are trapped in present-day Vancouver. Cameron needs to stop Liber8 before it can take down the corporations which will one day rule the world -- thus altering the course of the future and changing the 2077 that Cameron calls home. She enlists the help of a teenage tech genius named Alec Sadler to help figure out a way to get her back to her own time, and she manages to work with the Vancouver Police Department with Detective Carlos Fonnegra to keep an eye on Liber8. With different ideals and backgrounds, Cameron and Fonnegra clash, but they trust each other, and Cameron is slowly learning to trust herself as well.
Kiera and Carlos's reunion is a bumpy one as they attempt to thwart Liber8's brazen hijacking of a prison transfer; Kellog approaches Alec with a partnership proposition.

Una mujer con una orden judicial intenta escapar de las autoridades. Los oficiales acuden a un llamado y descubren pruebas de una pelea sangrienta.

Un enfrentamiento en una tienda se convierte en una pelea en un estacionamiento. Un pasajero de automóvil descoordinado capta la atención de los oficiales. Un hombre sospechoso jura que se asomó a una tienda cerrada porque quería leer su menú.
Los nervios traicionan a una mujer que intenta escapar de un agente en bicicleta. Por otro lado, las elecciones de los condimentos de un hombre alertan a la policía.

Una familia desafortunada tiene un duro despertar cuando un conductor ebrio choca en su entrada. A pesar de que su licencia está suspendida, un hombre lleva a su padre a casa. Un auto repleto de adolescentes es detenido camino al cine.

Los vehículos salen a toda velocidad de un estacionamiento cuando los oficiales llegan para terminar una carrera callejera. Además, un conductor algo torpe intenta hacer bromas para disminuir la seriedad de su error.

Un motociclista tiene suerte de estar vivo luego de haber chocado en una calle oscura. Los oficiales interrogan a dos pasajeros durante una detención. Además, un conductor joven le admite a la policía que su situación no es la mejor.

El cumpleaños de una mujer termina en una persecución. Los oficiales se muestran escépticos cuando un sospechoso afirma que le dieron un obsequio. Una abuela viene al rescate de un joven sin licencia de conducir que es intervenido por la policía.

Un conductor escapa cuando la policía le pide que se detenga. Un joven es detenido de camino a una fiesta. Los oficiales deben ayudar a una mujer angustiada cuando su exnovio la deja afuera de su casa.

Un sospechoso de intrusión y violación de la propiedad hace muchas preguntas en lugar de responderlas. Los investigadores descubren contrabando durante una inspección de tráfico. Además, una expareja hace todo lo posible para tolerarse por unas horas hasta que uno se va a rehabilitación.

Los oficiales lidian con un hombre delirante que fue encontrado desnudo en el porche de su vecino. Un conductor trata de deshacerse de la policía a pie, pero deja sus zapatos atrás por error. Una pareja que discute mucho tiene problemas para superar un evento trágico.
Una madre protectora intenta esconder a su hija de la policía. La policía busca las llaves de una guantera. Un conductor de transporte compartido es detenido cuando su pasajero levanta sospechas.

Una familia llama a la policía cuando se da cuenta de que hay un intruso en su casa. Una madre le pide a su hijo que busque ayuda después de que los agentes encuentran algunos artículos desagradables en su automóvil.

La posibilidad de una fuerte condena asusta a un sospechoso y lo incita a huir de un agente. Los oficiales hablan con dos padres que necesitan ayuda. La policía trata de contener a una mujer iracunda que atacó a su exnovio con un martillo.
Un ladrón insiste en que tenía intenciones de donar a la caridad lo que robó. La policía encuentra a un supuesto fanático del béisbol con numerosos artículos ilícitos en su auto.

Un conductor en apariencia pacífico genera problemas. Un infractor de tráfico conocido es atrapado con más de una licencia suspendida. El aviso de desalojo no impide que una mujer entre en un remolque.

Una mujer rebelde toma la decisión equivocada mientras su novio observa lo que sucede. Los agentes no se dejan engañar fácilmente por mentiras y trucos. La policía interviene cuando, casualmente, encuentran a un padre y su hijo peleándose en público.

Un oficial confronta a una pareja en una parada de autobús y la situación se intensifica. Un hombre llama a su novia para decirle que sus planes de fiesta están cancelados. Una mujer denunciada por conducir ebria jura que su exesposo arregló todo.

La policía se sorprende cuando un hombre, sospechoso de haber cometido un robo, regresa para apoyar a su compañero criminal. Un tipo que admite haber consumido drogas dice que lo hace de forma responsable.

La policía persigue a un hombre que escapó en un ciclomotor de mala calidad que no puede alcanzar altas velocidades. Una mujer afirma que una relación tóxica que mantuvo es la culpable del contenido de su automóvil.

Tras una persecución en auto, la policía busca pistas para encontrar la verdad. Una mujer frustrada trata de hacer entrar en razón a un hombre que no quiere afrontar la realidad. Un oficial tiene una charla sincera con un veterano con mala suerte.

Un sospechoso sale del auto de su amigo cuando los agentes lo atrapan haciendo un movimiento sospechoso. Un conductor niega que la ropa sea suya antes de que se lo pregunten. Un hombre dispara algunas rondas y pone su vecindario al límite.

Un conductor fugitivo intenta escapar de la policía. Los oficiales le solicitan al empleado de un concesionario de automóviles que coloque más cámaras de seguridad. Un agente irrumpe en un explosivo incidente doméstico.

Durante una persecución, los pasajeros abandonan el vehículo uno tras otro. Los oficiales descubren un artículo dudoso en los pantalones de un sospechoso. Los pasajeros de un vehículo robado afirman que fueron víctimas de una mujer.
Paulina y Rafael quieren vivir una historia donde las diferencias económicas no importan y otras personas harán todo lo posible para separarlos.

La serie cuenta, en cada capítulo, una historia diferente con personajes nuevos. El eje central de las historias es el transporte público, ya que todas ellas suceden dentro de alguno de los medios de traslado del país.

El antiguo Iron Chef Michiba decide que Morimoto necesita ayuda para encontrar su camino, así que recluta a su sous chef número uno de sus propios días en el Estadio de la Cocina.
El Iron Chef italiano es desafiado por un chef proveniente de Kioto.

El chef Takaji Yoshida se enfrenta al chef Masaharu Morimoto a quien quiere demostrar que su estilo en la comida japonesa lo hará obtener la victoria, realizando platillos con tofu como el ingrediente especial.
El Meiji Kinenkan es el salón nupcial más antiguo de Japón que se está reformando para celebrar su 50.º aniversario, lo que incluye la incorporación de un restaurante chino y su nuevo gran chef.
Iron Chef Chen hace su mejor presentación de yogur contra el retador Junichi Ito, conocido como el científico de la cocina.

Iron Chef es llamado a enfrentarse a Miyoko Sakai, una afamada crítica gastronómica tailandesa que ha tenido el privilegio de conocer los secretos de la cocina real tailandesa directamente de la fuente.
El cocinero con el mejor plato gana la inmunidad; los chefs preparan una comida para la anfitriona de televisión María Menounos y el actor Jeremy Sisto.

Ramsay prueba la capacidad de los concursantes de comunicarse y trabajar juntos con una carrera de relevos de tres entradas, y los ganadores obtienen un viaje de helicópteros y una degustación de caviar.
Los chefs son sorprendidos por miembros familiares y luego participan en prueba de olla a presión.
Un equipo de ganadores anteriores vuelve a desafiar a los demás concursantes; cada equipo diseña sus propios menús para la cena.
Los últimos cinco chefs deben impresionar a los críticos difíciles con una hamburguesa gourmet; un gran paso en falso lleva el servicio de cena a su fin; un chef es eliminado.
El chef Ramsay debe hacer muchos cambios a un pequeño restaurante en Bellmore, Nueva York. The Mixing Bowl enfrenta una afluencia de competencia y apenas tiene clientes.
Gordon hace cambios serios en un restaurante italiano, el Fair Lawn, de Nueva Jersey, que está perdiendo dinero. La policía interrumpe una fiesta durante la reapertura del restaurante.

El chef Ramsay intenta mejorar las cosas en un pequeño restaurante italiano llamado Peter's, dirigido por una familia en Babylon, Nueva York, pero se enfrenta a una persona malhumorada muy parecida a "El Padrino".
El chef Gordon Ramsay utiliza su magia en un restaurante de Tuckahoe, Nueva York, que ha sido renovado, pero aun así tiene un servicio y una comida muy malos.
El chef Ramsay está en la Gran Manzana para remodelar Dillon's, un restaurante indio a solo unas cuadras de su próspero restaurante.

El chef Gordon Ramsay visita Trobiano's, un restaurante italiano que debe medio millón de dólares. Durante una confrontación con el dueño acerca de la limpieza de la cocina y la calidad de la comida, el chef Ramsay se retira.

Sakai se enfrenta al "prestidigitador del ajo", un chef que abraza este ingrediente picante como lo hacen los verdaderos italianos; Sakai se enfrenta además al reto de utilizar calamares vivos en los platos.
A wealthy artist is found dead in the blazing studio of his home.
A patient confesses to murdering a psychiatric nurse at an asylum, but Blake isn't satisfied.
When a contestant in a TV game show is electrocuted in his dressing room, Blake suspects foul play.
A prospector is found dead in a mineshaft shortly after declaring he's struck gold.
A woman's body is found on a train at the same time a female surgeon is reported missing; someone makes indecent assaults while impersonating Frost.
Reid learns the identity of the assailant impersonating Frost, and the knowledge may cost both their lives.
Blake is called to investigate the case of a murdered retired carpenter, however, the only suspect is found praying over the body and covered in blood.
A housebound Blake tries his best to investigate the death of the school principal's daughter at her debutante ball.
Blake looks into the death of a farmer and a mysterious case of arson, while an unexpected party puts his future with Jean into jeopardy.
With a vacancy on the Signoria, Cosimo is asked to decide who should fill it; Piero is certain that his moment has finally arrived.
Pazzi manages to persuade the pope to remove the Medici as bankers to the Church, but Cosimo is not inclined to give up the role.
After a surprise attack, Lorenzo and Giuliano search for the culprits; the trail leads the brothers to the Pazzi, but treachery lies closer at hand.
Lorenzo's power play comes at a cost and stirs up outrage; with leadership comes sacrifice as he travels to Rome and weighs an advantageous match.

Charlie (Michael Douglas) gets released from an insane asylum and moves in with Miranda (Evan Rachel Wood), the young daughter he left behind. Charlie believes that there is treasure hidden beneath the local Costco, so he puts together a plan to unearth the loot. By convincing Miranda to quit her job at McDonald's and instead work at the wholesale store, he is able to obtain a key. Although Miranda is skeptical, she helps her father with his irrational quest.

An orphaned young girl, Jane Eyre, suffers humiliation and abuse at the hands of her aunt and is subsequently banished to a strict boarding school for several years. Upon her release, the adult Jane becomes a governess at Thornfield Hall, caring for the child of Mr. Rochester and his ailing wife. Jane and the enigmatic Rochester begin an intense relationship overshadowed by doubt and madness.
A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab.
An actor travels to Spain to find a playwright.
A priest (Tommy Lee Jones) and the girlfriend (Annette O'Toole) of a stabbed artist tie the murder to married art-gallery owners.

Gertrude Baniszewski, a divorced mother of several children, agrees to take care of two girls, Sylvia and Jennie, while their parents travel with a carnival. Though her eldest daughter is the real troublemaker, Gertrude vents all her bitterness and frustration on innocent Sylvia. Gertrude imprisons the girl in the basement and tortures her, eventually encouraging her children to follow suit.

Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.
On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students encounter a sixty-foot boa constrictor, hungry for blood.
Sailors go to sea to hunt for a prehistoric shark, previously thought to be extinct.
A giant octopus, mutated from years of radiation exposure, attacks a Navy submarine transporting a terrorist (Ravil Isyanov) captured by a CIA agent (Jay Harrington).
An actress (Samantha Eggar) escapes from an asylum to attend her husband's (John Vernon) casting session for starlets.
A herpetologist helps a detective track her flushed-away pet, now a king-size mutant called Ramone.

Two estranged sisters hatch a scheme to rob a bank to save their brother. The heist begins smoothly, but mayhem soon ensues when the defiant manager sends them to a basement-level vault where something truly evil dwells.

Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

A writer and his secret lover spend time at a remote cabin in the Appalachian Mountains to work on a horror novel. They learn several boys have gone missing, and after the writer's lover also disappears, he tries to solve the mystery.
Four friends travel into the Australian Outback to see Charlie's Farm, the site where a family met a gruesome end.
A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.
A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

Cuando una refugiada de los Balcanes aparece asesinada, la teniente Tennison se pone personalmente al mando para resolver el caso. Durante la investigación, Jane tiene que remontarse a los años de la guerra en Bosnia.
La presencia de Barnaby en la boda de la amiga de Sarah resulta fatídica cuando un asesino tiene como objetivo a las novias locales y conduce al detective a una misión para atrapar al asesino.
Barnaby debe enfrentarse a sus miedos luego de que los avistamientos de payasos, notas siniestras y la muerte acompañaron a Ferraees Circo a la ciudad.
Claudia asegura haber conocido a Cleopatra en su vida anterior y es investigada cuando ella revela un compartimiento secreto en el joyero de la reina egipcia.
Después de que un tranquilo antropólogo asesina a su asistente, él culpa a una daga antigua y Sídney y Nigel deben encontrar el secreto de su poder.
Una vasija en la que se cree se encuentra el Espíritu de un Gran Guerrero de la tribu Mochica es hallada y provoca un caos durante el viaje a casa de Sydney y Nigel.
Antes de la muerte del amigo de Sídney, él le envía un paquete que la conduce a la búsqueda para recuperar un antiguo tesoro gitano.
El padre de Sídney, un constructor de presas, la envía a China para recuperar una estatua sagrada de un grupo de monjes que rechazan abandonar el territorio de los Tres Ríos.
Sydney, Nigel y el millonario Rod Thorson viajan a la selva para hallar a un equipo de Buscadores de Reliquias que desapareció mientras buscaba el artefacto más antiguo del mundo.
Dos estudiantes graduados desaparecen mientras buscan la Cruz de Utu haitiana que supuestamente posee poderes increíbles.
Sydney y Nigel intentan salvar a una Buscadora de Reliquias novata de perder su cabeza mientras busca una mítica pechera de César.
Sídney y Nigel descubren lo que aparentan ser unos artefactos egipcios sin descubrir en un estudio de cine en Londres.
Después de una emboscada, Sídney es capturada por un cazador. Nigel y Claudia se enfrentan a cazadores rivales que quieren vender los tesoros por dinero.
Martin debe tratar a un anciano con un olor horrible. Un presentador de radio local parece tener un problema con la bebida. Julie Mitchell llega a Portwenn.
Culpan a Martín cuando un paciente muere durante un examen. Joan insta a Martín a explicar al viudo las circunstancias que rodean la muerte de Helen.
Martín se ve sorprendido y desconcertado cuando sus padres llegan repentinamente de visita. El examen de Martín a una mujer conduce a un diagnóstico sorpresa.

Tennison se lamenta por no haber sido capaz de salvar a la joven Yasmina, pero cree que el principal sospechoso no actuó solo. Para comprobarlo, la teniente viaja junto al reportero Robert West a Bosnia.
A punto de jubilarse, la inspectora jefe Jane Tennison debe investigar el brutal asesinato de una chica de 14 años.
Barnaby busca a un asesino en un pueblo abandonado que experimenta grandes cambios que ocultan más de unos pocos fantasmas del pasado.
Barnaby investiga la muerte de un miembro de un grupo de vigilancia que revela una oscura búsqueda por el control.
Ramsay anuncia a los dos chefs finalistas; los chefs viajan a Las Vegas antes de competir en un desafío culinario.
En el último episodio, las finalistas y sus equipos están preparados para la competición. ¿Quién será el ganador?
Feared L.A. crime boss Ezequiel Romo ruthlessly runs the streets of L.A., even from behind bars.
Joshua Gardner commits his first murder at 24; even behind bars, he can't contain his rage.
Imprisoned after a fatal robbery, Craig Wissink kills a corrections officer in a brutal attack.
After shooting two people, Rodney Berget kidnaps and sexually assaults a gas station clerk.
After murdering a woman in the woods, Rocky Beamon brutally kills two fellow inmates behind bars.
Jennifer Faith fabricates a life of abuse to convince a veteran to murder her husband in broad daylight.
Romance novelist Nancy Crampton-Brophy executes the plotline of her own essay "How to Murder Your Husband."
When the remains of a retired police chief are discovered, police are led to his partner, Marcy Oglesby.
Two criminals, who meet in prison while serving time for previous murders, strike up a friendship with deadly consequences.
Analysis of what drove Raoul Moat to commit his crimes.

In Texas, a husband fails to stop his wife from taking her own life with a gunshot to the back of her head; home surveillance reveals the truth; in Washington state, a man builds a bunker in secret with a diabolical plan for his wife and daughter.
Surveillance footage plays a central role in tracking down the killers in two murder cases.
The murders of Martika Ferguson and Tiffiney Crawford expose the deadly toll of disproportionate revenge.
When Arlene Fraser disappeared, her husband Nat had a watertight alibi; local cops weren't fooled.
Wanting to get rid of the husband she hated, Faria Khan launched a murderous plot involving a group of wannabe rappers.
On the day of their anniversary a man decides to go fishing but never makes it back home to his wife.
Glenna and Marty Duram have a volatile marriage, but no one suspects that it will end in a highly suspicious death.

Nick tries to contact a sentinel spirit and hopes it will divulge information about the other side.
Nick and his wife Tessa Groff contact workers who died while building tunnels beneath the house.

Investigators use CCTV footage to expose the truth behind Grace's disappearance.

Outlaws force Lucas to help with a prison break.
A young girl asks refuge at the McCain ranch for herself and her ill brother.
A gang comes to town to free a jailed member.
A drifter forces his attentions on a deaf girl.
A dapper man arrives on the stage and announces that he has come to kill Lucas.
Mark falls head-over-heels into his first puppy love.
A young man arrives in North Fork to claim the body of his dead brother.
A gunman threatens to kill Micah and Lucas tries to help.
Lucas is accused of murder by a man who claims to be an eyewitness.
Mark deliberately disobeys his father and a convicted prisoner escapes.
Lucas' friends label him a tinhorn because of his gambling.
A blind banjo-playing wanderer strikes up an acquaintance with Mark.
The McCains get new neighbors when a couple moves into a nearby ranch.
A Southern belle arrives in North Fork claiming that Micah is her husband.
Lucas regrets his attitude toward a reformed outlaw.
The new marshal is friends with a known outlaw.
A gambler moves into North Fork and begins courting a local girl.

A former friend of Lucas' is released from prison and asks him for a job.
Lucas, Mark and Micah are taken prisoner by a group of bandits.
Lucas, Mark and Micah escape from bandits and take refuge in a deserted building.
Lou Mallory, a stunning redhead, arrives in North Fork and buys the hotel.

A dapper little braggart invites challenge with tales of his gunfighting prowess.
An unscrupulous land buyer tries to get Lucas to sell his ranch.
Mark takes a sudden aversion to his father's rifle after one of his friends is killed.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

After the death of the British prime minister, the world's most powerful leaders gather in London to pay their respects. Without warning, terrorists unleash a devastating attack that leaves the city in chaos and ruins. Secret Service agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) springs into action to bring U.S. President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) to safety. When Asher falls into the hands of the sinister organization, it's up to Banning to save his commander in chief from a horrible fate.

Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.
Movie, Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery

Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.
Movie, Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure
Detective Philip Marlowe becomes embroiled in an investigation with a wealthy family in Bay City, Calif., after a beautiful blonde hires him to find her former lover.

Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty.

On the day of his retirement, detective Jerry Black (Jack Nicholson) accepts a gift -- an airline ticket to Mexico. But when the body of a murdered eight-year-old girl is discovered in the mountains, Jerry offers his expertise at the crime scene. When an ambitious younger cop wrenches a dubious confession from a simple-minded suspect, the case is closed... but not for Jerry.

John "Breacher" Wharton (Arnold Schwarzenegger) leads an elite DEA task force. Its latest mission is a high-stakes raid on a safe house owned by one of the world's deadliest drug cartels. Wharton and his team (Sam Worthington, Terrence Howard, Joe Manganiello) complete the mission successfully but secretly steal $10 million for themselves. They think their work is done -- until, one-by-one, the commandos are mysteriously killed. As the body count rises, everyone becomes a suspect.

Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.
Walker and Trivette protect the only remaining witness in a mob trial and Walker faces a conundrum when the witness is one of Alex's old beaus.
Walker and Trivette track a radical faction of the IRA after an assassination attempt is made on a member of a peace mission.
Walker is left alone undercover in a maximum security prison when his backup, Trivette, is discovered and exposed by the corrupt warden.
Sam becomes a convict in the electric chair moments before receiving a last-minute stay of execution, which gives him 48 hours to prove his innocence.

Sam becomes a wrestler who must prevent his brother from going down for the count permanently when their title match poses a threat to the man's life.

Reno runs into a personable modern-day Billy the Kid who cannot decide on which side of the law he should fight.
John Michael Higgins hosts as two teams of friends race against a clock to guess how America filled in the blanks on a series of survey questions covering every topic under the sun.

Teams compete to answer practical, everyday questions, such as how to revive flat champagne.

Blame for stealing a Porsche falls on students bused from a poor neighborhood, but the squad checks it out.
Hunter and McCall are invited to dinner by a multimillionaire who's convinced he's about to be murdered.

Detective Sgt. Rick Hunter fights crime in the San Diego area. The wily homicide investigator isn't afraid to break the rules as he pursues justice, though the perpetrators he and his partners are after frequently end up dead. Criticized for its graphic violence, the show also features witty banter between Hunter and his partner.

Jim Rockford is an ex-con and private detective. He was falsely convicted of a crime he didn't commit, but that doesn't stop him from using his ex-con buddies to help him solve crimes. Nothing comes easy for Rockford, but he works hard and usually gets shot at or beat up at least once per episode.
Walker's hands are tied when a technicality leads to the release of the man convicted of kidnapping Alex, and the man comes looking for revenge.
Rico Verhoeven defends his title against Jamal Ben Saddik along with three additional fights from the GelreDome in Arnhem, Netherlands.
Featuring a Jamal Ben Saddik vs. Benjamin Adegbuyi rematch and Donovan Wisse vs. Juri De Sousa for GLORY middleweight title in kickboxing action from Düsseldorf, Germany. From Aug. 20, 2022.

From "Polar," to "James Bond" to "Lethal Weapon," Terry loves action movies and is putting some of the best ones to the test!

In addition to marksmanship and long-range shooting, military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

Laura and Nick travel to a state-of-the-art direct effects lightning test lab. With some "explosive" experiments, they'll determine the power of lightning, and they'll find out how hunters and fishermen can protect themselves.

A new gardening year begins at Longmeadow and Monty reveals his new plans for the year as well as taking stock of any winter damage. Monty gives tips on moving plants which are in the wrong place or have outgrown their space, shows how to store chillies and harvests the last of his tomatoes. Rachel de Thame returns to Longmeadow to talk to Monty about her return to health and to plant up pots for spring colour.

With autumn well under way, some plants in the garden need to be brought in under cover. In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.
Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.

Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. Monty revels in the roses in his garden, harvests honey from his bees and gives advice on the maintenance of hardy geraniums as well as planting others for summer ground cover. Rachel de Thame shows how the most ordinary of spaces can be transformed by adding seasonal containers.

With Halloween approaching, Monty takes stock of his pumpkins and squashes, plants up alpines and shows how to divide a large fern to create new plants. Meanwhile, Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit Hever Castle in Kent.

Monty Don prepares the flowering borders for winter and makes a bonfire, Carol celebrates our berry-laden hedgerows, and Rachel visits Julian Clary in his garden.

A celebration of people who are growing their own, from vegetables to flowers, across the UK. At Longmeadow, Monty shares tips and advice on how to get the most out of bargain plants. Meanwhile, Joe visits an extraordinary food project in Bristol.

Monty's in the jewel garden showing which plants need protection from the elements now and which ones can be left until after the first frosts. He also plants out berried shrubs to help feed wildlife in the winter, harvests pumpkins and shows how to make use of fallen autumnal leaves.

In the cottage garden, Monty is moving a rose which has outgrown its space and in the vegetable garden he gives advice on what to plant now for spring. He also finds out more about the mysterious world of earthworms and discovers why they are vital for the garden.
Monty catches up with summer maintenance in his wildlife garden and recommends plants for deep, dry shade under trees, as well as giving advice on what to plant now for late summer harvests.
Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

Monty Don gets going with some autumn garden maintenance whilst looking back over the year and reviewing his borders - which plants have done well and others that haven't. Carol Klein is at Glebe Cottage continuing work on her new raised beds and taming an overgrown and unruly rambling rose.

Monty's thoughts turn to spring when he gives recommendations for bulbs to plant that will thrive in pots. He also shows how to prune summer fruiting raspberries. In Norfolk, Frances Tophill visits a gardener who at 97 still gardens every day.

Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Frances Tophill meets a gardener whose allotment is filled with both traditional and exotic vegetables and Toby Buckland visits The Newt in Somerset to find out about its chequered garden history and to explore its emergence as one of the UK's most exciting gardens.

With autumn fast approaching, Monty is preparing the borders for the change of seasons and looking ahead to spring. Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit a glorious historic garden in North Yorkshire - Scampston Hall.

This time there's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come, and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit keen gardeners, Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style. Carol Klein's exploring the history of the rose at Coughton Court, one of our best rose gardens and Monty plants a new rose of his own. What happens when you have to downsize and leave your much-loved garden?
Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

At Longmeadow, Monty plans for next spring when he plants some early-flowering wildflowers and gives his recipes for the different compost mixes he uses to take successful cuttings. Monty propagates succulent plants, revisits his container vegetable garden, and gives advice on how to get a good crop of pumpkins. Adam looks a new garden at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex, and Rachel visits a garden of vibrant colours in Wiltshire.

The Welsh chefs raise the curtain with their starters, but which one is going to produce a showstopper? All three contestants have created sophisticated plates of food with simple dish titles. The Welsh chefs cook their fish course. Richard Davies serves up grilled and tartare of mackerel, while Mary Ann Gilchrist serves a lobster dish and calls it 'The Great Escape'. Luke Thomas is hoping that his quirky take on a classic fish finger will impress veteran Jeremy Lee too.

The Welsh chefs prepare their main courses, but will any of them impress veteran Jeremy Lee enough to give them a top score? Richard Davies's dish is simply called 'A Tasting of Pork', Mary Ann Gilchrist's 'Three's a Crowd' doesn't give much away, while Luke Thomas's dish is called 'Beef, Bone Marrow and Watercress'.

It's the final chance for the Welsh chefs to impress Jeremy Lee with their dessert dishes. Which creation will help get two chefs through to the judging show? Will it be Richard Davies's strawberries and cream with a Comic Relief twist, or will Mary Ann Gilchrist's 'Some Like It Hot' or Luke Thomas's rhubarb and custard get them through?

It's decision time for the chefs representing Wales - the two remaining chefs cook their entire menus for judges Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton as well as celebrity guest judge Emma Kennedy.

Three North East chefs all want to top the leader board on day one with their starter. How will Colin McGurran's tomato gazpacho and garden salad perform? Stephanie Moon thinks she also has a chance with a witty chicken dish called 'Why Did the Chicken...', and Charlie Lakin offers a controversial duck dish called 'Mind Your Step'.

The North East chefs cook their fish courses. Will former champion Colin McGurran's dish of cockles and mussels with salmon, inspired by his childhood memories, also inspire veteran judge Jason Atherton? Or perhaps Stephanie Moon's fish dish with a nod to one of the most famous gags of all time, crab custard pie, will be the winner? Charlie Lakin is also confident with his creation called 'Tongue in Cheek'.

Will Colin McGurran's duck and turnips recipe turn out funnier than it sounds? Has Stephanie Moon dropped the comedy ball with her 'Behind the Fun is Some Serious Game'? Will Charlie Lakin's kebab-inspired 'A Night on the Tiles' raise a smile?

It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress before the final two are chosen to face the `Great British Menu' judging panel. Which desserts will help get two chefs through to the showdown? It's decision time for the chefs from the North East. One chef has already left the competition and only two remain. They must now cook their entire menus for the "Great British Menu" judges Prue Leith, Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton and their guest, comedian Tim Brooke-Taylor. The judges aren't easily pleased and only world-class cooking will do.

The curtain raises on the competition in Northern Ireland. How will Chris Fearon cope competing against his former head chef Raymond McArdle? Will rising star Ian Orr be caught up in the middle? Both Chris and Raymond create very different takes on soup while Ian comes up with a rabbit dish.

The three Northern Ireland chefs cook their fish courses. Chris Fearon serves up a creation called 'Stitched up Like a Kipper', while Raymond McArdle draws inspiration from a view from home and serves turbot called 'A Day at the Beach'. Ian Orr creates a dish with a play on an old joke called 'Why Did the Scallop Cross the Roe'.

It's time for the main course. Chris Fearon's dish called 'Cowboy Supper' is inspired by the Wild West. Raymond McArdle creates a dish called 'Titanic Smoked Venison, Tongue and Cheek', and Ian Orr cooks lamb and baked hay.

It's the chefs' last chance to impress before the final two are chosen to face the 'Great British Menu' judging panel. Which dessert will it be? Chris Fearon's dish inspired by comedy legend Tommy Cooper called 'Just Like That?' competes against Raymond McArdle's 'Chocolate Volcano Mountain' and Ian Orr's 'Passion Egg'.

It's decision time for the chefs from Northern Ireland. One chef has left the competition and only two remain. Who will cook their entire menus for the 'Great British Menu' judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton? They will be joined by celebrity guest judge writer and performer Charlie Higson and the judges aren't easily pleased.

It's the main course and rabbit, rose veal and venison are all dished up for 'Great British Menu' veteran Richard Corrigan. Plus, one of the chefs is joined by 'EastEnders' star June Brown for a fundraising challenge.

It's the dessert course. Will a strawberry and coconut dessert, a frozen white chocolate dish or apple and cherries come out on top? 'Great British Menu' veteran judge Richard Corrigan will decide who goes through to the judges tomorrow.

It is decision time for the chefs from London and the South East. One chef left the competition last time and only two remain. They will cook their entire menus for the "Great British Menu" judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. This time they will be joined by celebrity guest judge, comedienne and writer Arabella Weir.
Renowned actress Patricia Hodge, one of the stars of British sitcom "Miranda", joins judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort to taste all eight winning regional starter courses.

The chefs cook their fish courses. Who will make it to the top three and the special banquet? Tensions are high, but a Sicilian influenced dish called the 'Cod Father' brings some laughs. Impressionist Ronni Ancona joins the judges.

It's judgement day as the chefs not only learn the top three desserts, but the judges announce the winning menu. 'Fast Show' writer and performer Charlie Higson helps judge the puddings. Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort decide on the four winning dishes, but there is a problem - they are torn between two dishes for one of the courses.

It's the climax of the competition as the winning chefs cook for the Comic Relief Banquet at the Royal Albert Hall. Richard Curtis welcomes the unsung heroes, beneficiaries and celebrities who have inspired us to do something funny for money.

Three of Scotland's top chefs, Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee, and Graham Campbell - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge. Having missed out last year, returning finalist Jak is determined to make it to the banquet.

Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell fight it out for the fish course. Graham is in a confident mood but returning finalist Jak and self-taught Jimmy are pushing him hard. Will the pressure prove too much for ambitious Graham?

Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell are battling to plate up a perfect main course for this week's veteran chef. Self-taught Jimmy is honouring his mum with his rendition of her Chinese beef stew.

Today it's the Scottish chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow, and with one chef in the lead after a triumphant main, the pressures on for the other two to plate up perfection.

A crew of retired crooks pulls off a major heist in London's jewelry district.

A case of mistaken identity puts a man named Slevin (Josh Hartnett) in the middle of a war between two rival New York crime lords: The Rabbi (Ben Kingsley) and the Boss (Morgan Freeman). A former MI5 agent (Peter Firth) investigates the disappearance of Harry Pearce (Kit Harington) when the operative is blamed for the escape of a ruthless terrorist (Elyes Gabel).
Recruited by British intelligence, a Texas Ranger must track down and stop a dangerous terrorist from attacking London.

As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

CIA agent Bill Pope (Ryan Reynolds) dies while traveling to a secret location to meet a hacker who can launch missiles at will. Desperate to find his whereabouts, officials turn to an experimental neurosurgeon who can transfer memories from one brain to another. The guinea pig for the procedure is Jerico Stewart (Kevin Costner), a violent and dangerous death-row inmate. Now gifted with Pope's skills and knowledge, Stewart must race against time to stop a sinister international conspiracy.
The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

Ernest Selby (George O'Brien) is a wealthy man who was born and raised in luxury in the Eastern United States. But all that changes when he moves out West to oversee the cattle ranch that he has recently inherited. Selby is stunned to learn that his cows are regularly being stolen. So, when he is mistaken for a lowly cowhand, Selby decides to go undercover to find out who has been stealing the cattle. Along the way, Selby falls for the beautiful damsel Ann Hepburn (Irene Hervey).
An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

The Three Mesquiteers -- Stony Brooke (Robert Livingston), Tucson Smith (Ray Corrigan) and Lullaby Joslin (Max Terhune) -- suspect the unscrupulous Rance McGowan (J.P. McGowan) of supplementing his income by rustling a breed of wild horses protected by the federal government. When Sheriff Miller (Edward Cassidy) gets trampled to death by an unknown horse, the Mesquiteers seek vengeance for his orphaned son. Meanwhile, Brooke angers Smith by courting saloon girl Rita (Rita Cansino).
A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

Ranchers and turpentiners fight over a forest in Georgia. The ranchers want to clear the land so their cattle can have more room to graze, while the turpentiners want to save the trees for their sap. Meanwhile, rancher Gene leaves the area and joins a traveling Wild West show, and violence erupts between the two sides soon after. Gene returns two years later to find things in disarray and cattle rustler Len Parker fueling tensions and plotting his own land grab.
A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.
A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.
A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan comes to the aid of Jude Pilchuk, a fellow hunter whose wagon was run off the trail by white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians. Doan and Pilchuk investigate and discover that Randall Jett-- the abusive father of Doan's love interest Milly Fayre-- is to blame. When Jett then kidnaps Milly and disappears into the wild, Doan must track down and outsmart Jett's gang to save the woman he loves.
A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

In this musical Western, rival horse-breeders Jeff Adams (Joseph Crehan) and Brock Danvers (Onslow Stevens) are in a fierce competition over a lucrative government contract. But the hopes of the Adams family are dashed after Jeff dies while riding the tempestuous stallion Trigger. To the rescue, then, comes quintessential cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers), who saves the horse from vengeful slaughter and aims to train him in the hope of securing the contract on behalf of his departed friend.

Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.
Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) helps his friend Johnny (Jay Kirby) find out where rustlers are hiding stolen cattle.
Three U.S. Marshals (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) work undercover to foil a gang of racketeers.

Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

After the Civil War, friends Dan Taylor (Richard Dix) and Paxton Bryce (Preston Foster) yearn for new lives. Learning of Beauchard's intent to cheat them, the men keep his cattle, and Paxton convinces Dan to turn to cattle ranching. Their ranch becomes successful, and Paxton eventually marries Dan's sister, Abby (Frances Gifford) -- but Beauchard soon returns to challenge them.
